136	pub fn read_png_exif_from_bytes(data : Bytes) -> Bytes? {
137	  let len = data.length()
138	  if len < 8 ||
139	    data[0].to_int() != 0x89 ||
140	    data[1].to_int() != 0x50 ||
141	    data[2].to_int() != 0x4E ||
142	    data[3].to_int() != 0x47 {
143	    return None
144	  }
145	  let mut pos = 8
146	  while pos + 8 <= len {
147	    let chunk_len = data[pos].to_int() * 16777216 +
148	      data[pos + 1].to_int() * 65536 +
149	      data[pos + 2].to_int() * 256 +
150	      data[pos + 3].to_int()
151	    let type0 = data[pos + 4].to_int()
152	    let type1 = data[pos + 5].to_int()
153	    let type2 = data[pos + 6].to_int()
154	    let type3 = data[pos + 7].to_int()
155	    let data_start = pos + 8
156	    if data_start + chunk_len > len {
157	      break	<-- UNCOVERED
158	    }
159	    // eXIf: type = 0x65 0x58 0x49 0x66
160	    if type0 == 0x65 && type1 == 0x58 && type2 == 0x49 && type3 == 0x66 {
161	      let exif : Array[Byte] = []
162	      for i in 0..<chunk_len {
163	        exif.push(data[data_start + i])
164	      }
165	      return Some(Bytes::from_array(exif))
166	    }
167	    // IEND
168	    if type0 == 0x49 && type1 == 0x45 && type2 == 0x4E && type3 == 0x44 {
169	      break
170	    }
171	    pos = data_start + chunk_len + 4
172	  }
173	  None
174	}

346	pub fn msrcr_16(
347	  img : @types.Image16,

349	  gain~ : Float = 1.0F,

357	  }

360	  }

362	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
363	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
364	      "msrcr_16: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +

368	    )

372	  }

386	  ]
387	  for c in 0..<3 {
388	    for i in 0..<n {

394	    Array::make(n, 0.0F),

398	  for c in 0..<3 {

449	pub fn msrcr_f(
450	  img : @types.ImageF,
451	  sigmas~ : Array[Float] = [15.0F, 80.0F, 250.0F],
452	  gain~ : Float = 1.0F,
453	  offset~ : Float = 0.0F,
454	  alpha~ : Float = 125.0F,
455	  beta~ : Float = 46.0F,
456	) -> @types.ImageF raise @types.LoadError {
457	  if img.channels != 3 && img.channels != 4 {
458	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("msrcr_f 需要 RGB/RGBA 图像")
459	  }
460	  if sigmas.length() == 0 {
461	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("sigmas 不能为空")	<-- UNCOVERED
462	  }
463	  let ch = img.channels
464	  let w = img.width
465	  let h = img.height
466	  let n = w * h
467	  if n == 0 {
468	    return img	<-- UNCOVERED
469	  }
470	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * ch * 4, b'\x00')
471	  let num_scales = sigmas.length()
472	  let channels : Array[Array[Float]] = [
473	    Array::make(n, 0.0F),
474	    Array::make(n, 0.0F),
475	    Array::make(n, 0.0F),
476	  ]
477	  for c in 0..<3 {
478	    for i in 0..<n {
479	      let v = read_f32_r(img.data, (i * ch + c) * 4)
480	      channels[c][i] = if v <= 0.0F { 0.0001F } else { v }
481	    }
482	  }
483	  let msr_results : Array[Array[Float]] = [
484	    Array::make(n, 0.0F),
485	    Array::make(n, 0.0F),
486	    Array::make(n, 0.0F),
487	  ]
488	  for c in 0..<3 {
489	    let log_channel : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
490	    for i in 0..<n {
491	      log_channel[i] = logf_r(channels[c][i])
492	    }
493	    let retinex_sum : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
494	    for sigma in sigmas {
495	      let blurred = gaussian_blur_channel(channels[c], w, h, sigma)
496	      for i in 0..<n {
497	        let log_b = logf_r(if blurred[i] > 0.0F { blurred[i] } else { 1.0F })
498	        retinex_sum[i] += log_channel[i] - log_b
499	      }
500	    }
501	    let inv_scales = 1.0F / Float::from_int(num_scales)
502	    for i in 0..<n {
503	      msr_results[c][i] = retinex_sum[i] * inv_scales
504	    }
505	  }
506	  for i in 0..<n {
507	    let sum = channels[0][i] + channels[1][i] + channels[2][i]
508	    for c in 0..<3 {
509	      let crf = logf_r(alpha * channels[c][i] / (sum + 1.0F)) * beta
510	      let val = msr_results[c][i] * gain + offset + crf
511	      write_f32_r(out, (i * ch + c) * 4, val)
512	    }
513	    if ch == 4 {
514	      let v = read_f32_r(img.data, (i * ch + 3) * 4)	<-- UNCOVERED
515	      write_f32_r(out, (i * ch + 3) * 4, v)
516	    }
517	  }
518	  @types.ImageF::{
519	    width: w,
520	    height: h,
521	    channels: ch,
522	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),
523	  }
524	}

213	pub fn compare_hist(
214	  hist1 : Array[Int32],
215	  hist2 : Array[Int32],
216	  compare_method : HistCompareMethod,
217	) -> Float raise @types.LoadError {
218	  // 参数验证
219	  if hist1.length() == 0 {
220	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
221	      "compare_hist: hist1数组不能为空",
222	    )
223	  }
224	  if hist2.length() == 0 {
225	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
226	      "compare_hist: hist2数组不能为空",
227	    )
228	  }
229	  if hist1.length() != hist2.length() {
230	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
231	      "compare_hist: hist1和hist2长度必须相同",
232	    )
233	  }
234	
235	  let n = hist1.length()
236	  match compare_method {
237	    Correlation => {
238	      let mut sum1 = 0.0F
239	      let mut sum2 = 0.0F
240	      let mut sum12 = 0.0F
241	      let mut sum1_sq = 0.0F
242	      let mut sum2_sq = 0.0F
243	      for i in 0..<n {
244	        let h1 = Float::from_int(hist1[i])
245	        let h2 = Float::from_int(hist2[i])
246	        sum1 += h1
247	        sum2 += h2
248	        sum12 += h1 * h2
249	        sum1_sq += h1 * h1
250	        sum2_sq += h2 * h2
251	      }
252	      let nf = Float::from_int(n)
253	      let num = nf * sum12 - sum1 * sum2
254	      let den = ((nf * sum1_sq - sum1 * sum1) * (nf * sum2_sq - sum2 * sum2)).sqrt()
255	      if den == 0.0F {
256	        0.0F	<-- UNCOVERED
257	      } else {
258	        num / den
259	      }
260	    }
261	    ChiSquare => {
262	      let mut chi = 0.0F
263	      for i in 0..<n {
264	        let h1 = Float::from_int(hist1[i])
265	        let h2 = Float::from_int(hist2[i])
266	        let diff = h1 - h2
267	        let sum = h1 + h2
268	        if sum > 0.0F {
269	          chi += diff * diff / sum
270	        }
271	      }
272	      chi
273	    }
274	    Bhattacharyya => {
275	      let mut bc = 0.0F
276	      let mut s1 = 0.0F
277	      let mut s2 = 0.0F
278	      for i in 0..<n {
279	        let h1 = Float::from_int(hist1[i])
280	        let h2 = Float::from_int(hist2[i])

393	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
394	      "gaussian_blur_f: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
395	    )
396	  }
397	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
398	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
399	      "gaussian_blur_f: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
400	    )
401	  }
402	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels * 4
403	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
404	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
405	      "gaussian_blur_f: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
406	      expected_size.to_string() +
407	      "，实际 " +
408	      img.data.length().to_string(),
409	    )
410	  }
411	  if radius < 0 {
412	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("gaussian_blur_f: radius不能为负")	<-- UNCOVERED
413	  }
414	  if sigma <= 0.0F {
415	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("gaussian_blur_f: sigma必须大于0")
416	  }
417	  if radius <= 0 {
418	    return img
419	  }
420	  let w = img.width
421	  let h = img.height
422	  let ch = img.channels
423	  let color_ch = if ch >= 3 { 3 } else { ch }
424	  let n = w * h
425	  let win_size = 2 * radius + 1
426	  let bpp = ch * 4
427	  // 生成 1D 高斯核
428	  let kernel : Array[Float] = Array::make(win_size, 0.0F)
429	  let two_sigma_sq = 2.0F * sigma * sigma
430	  let mut ksum = 0.0F
431	  for i in 0..<win_size {
432	    let x = Float::from_int(i - radius)
433	    let val = @math.expf(-(x * x) / two_sigma_sq)
434	    kernel[i] = val
435	    ksum += val
436	  }
437	  for i in 0..<win_size {
438	    kernel[i] = kernel[i] / ksum
439	  }
440	  // 预计算像素 Float 数组
441	  let src : Array[Float] = Array::make(n * color_ch, 0.0F)
442	  for i in 0..<n {
443	    for c in 0..<color_ch {
444	      src[i * color_ch + c] = read_f32_le_f(img.data, i * bpp + c * 4)
445	    }
446	  }
447	  // 水平模糊：src -> temp (Float)
448	  let temp : Array[Float] = Array::make(n * color_ch, 0.0F)
449	  let x_inner_start = if radius >= w { w } else { radius }
450	  let x_inner_end = if radius >= w { w } else { w - radius }
451	  for y in 0..<h {
452	    let row_base = y * w
453	    for c in 0..<color_ch {
454	      for x in x_inner_start..<x_inner_end {
455	        let mut acc = 0.0F
456	        let base = (row_base + x - radius) * color_ch + c
457	        for k in 0..<win_size {
458	          acc += kernel[k] * src[base + k * color_ch]
459	        }
460	        temp[(row_base + x) * color_ch + c] = acc
461	      }
462	      for x in 0..<x_inner_start {
463	        let mut acc = 0.0F
464	        for k in 0..<win_size {
465	          let sx = @types.clamp_coord(x + k - radius, w)
466	          acc += kernel[k] * src[(row_base + sx) * color_ch + c]
467	        }
468	        temp[(row_base + x) * color_ch + c] = acc
469	      }
470	      for x in x_inner_end..<w {
471	        let mut acc = 0.0F
472	        for k in 0..<win_size {
473	          let sx = @types.clamp_coord(x + k - radius, w)
474	          acc += kernel[k] * src[(row_base + sx) * color_ch + c]
475	        }
476	        temp[(row_base + x) * color_ch + c] = acc
477	      }
478	    }
479	  }
480	  // 垂直模糊：temp -> out
481	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * bpp, b'\x00')
482	  let y_inner_start = if radius >= h { h } else { radius }
483	  let y_inner_end = if radius >= h { h } else { h - radius }
484	  for x in 0..<w {
485	    for c in 0..<color_ch {
486	      for y in y_inner_start..<y_inner_end {
487	        let mut acc = 0.0F
488	        let base = ((y - radius) * w + x) * color_ch + c
489	        for k in 0..<win_size {
490	          acc += kernel[k] * temp[base + k * w * color_ch]
491	        }
492	        write_f32_le_f(out, (y * w + x) * bpp + c * 4, acc)
493	      }
494	      for y in 0..<y_inner_start {
495	        let mut acc = 0.0F
496	        for k in 0..<win_size {
497	          let sy = @types.clamp_coord(y + k - radius, h)
498	          acc += kernel[k] * temp[(sy * w + x) * color_ch + c]
499	        }
500	        write_f32_le_f(out, (y * w + x) * bpp + c * 4, acc)
501	      }
502	      for y in y_inner_end..<h {
503	        let mut acc = 0.0F
504	        for k in 0..<win_size {
505	          let sy = @types.clamp_coord(y + k - radius, h)
506	          acc += kernel[k] * temp[(sy * w + x) * color_ch + c]
507	        }
508	        write_f32_le_f(out, (y * w + x) * bpp + c * 4, acc)
509	      }
510	    }
511	  }
512	  // 复制 alpha
513	  if ch == 4 {
514	    for i in 0..<n {	<-- UNCOVERED
515	      let alpha_off = i * bpp + 12
516	      for b in 0..<4 {
517	        out[alpha_off + b] = img.data[alpha_off + b]	<-- UNCOVERED
518	      }
519	    }
520	  }
521	  @types.ImageF::{
522	    width: w,
523	    height: h,
524	    channels: ch,
525	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),
526	  }

533	pub fn median_blur_16(
534	  img : @types.Image16,
535	  ksize : Int32,
536	) -> @types.Image16 raise @types.LoadError {
537	  // 输入验证
538	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
539	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
540	      "median_blur_16: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
541	    )
542	  }
543	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
544	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
545	      "median_blur_16: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
546	    )
547	  }
548	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels * 2
549	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
550	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
551	      "median_blur_16: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
552	      expected_size.to_string() +
553	      "，实际 " +
554	      img.data.length().to_string(),
555	    )
556	  }
557	  if ksize <= 0 {
558	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("median_blur_16: ksize必须大于0")
559	  }
560	  if ksize % 2 == 0 {
561	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("median_blur_16: ksize必须为奇数")
562	  }
563	  if ksize <= 1 {
564	    return img
565	  }
566	  let radius = ksize / 2
567	  let w = img.width
568	  let h = img.height
569	  let ch = img.channels
570	  let color_ch = if ch >= 3 { 3 } else { ch }
571	  let n = w * h
572	  let bpp = ch * 2
573	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * bpp, b'\x00')
574	  let buf : Array[Int32] = Array::make(ksize * ksize, 0)
575	  for y in 0..<h {
576	    for x in 0..<w {
577	      for c in 0..<color_ch {
578	        let mut idx = 0
579	        for dy in -radius..<=radius {
580	          for dx in -radius..<=radius {
581	            let sx = @types.clamp_coord(x + dx, w)
582	            let sy = @types.clamp_coord(y + dy, h)
583	            buf[idx] = read_u16_le_f(img.data, (sy * w + sx) * bpp + c * 2)
584	            idx += 1
585	          }
586	        }
587	        let mid = ksize * ksize / 2
588	        let mut lo = 0
589	        let mut hi = ksize * ksize - 1
590	        while lo < hi {
591	          let pivot = buf[(lo + hi) / 2]
592	          let mut i = lo
593	          let mut j = hi
594	          while i <= j {
595	            while buf[i] < pivot {
596	              i += 1
597	            }
598	            while buf[j] > pivot {
599	              j -= 1
600	            }
601	            if i <= j {
602	              let tmp = buf[i]
603	              buf[i] = buf[j]
604	              buf[j] = tmp
605	              i += 1
606	              j -= 1
607	            }
608	          }
609	          if mid <= j {
610	            hi = j
611	          } else if mid >= i {
612	            lo = i
613	          } else {
614	            lo = mid
615	            hi = mid
616	          }
617	        }
618	        write_u16_le_f(out, (y * w + x) * bpp + c * 2, buf[mid])
619	      }
620	    }
621	  }
622	  // 复制 alpha
623	  if ch == 4 {
624	    for i in 0..<n {	<-- UNCOVERED
625	      let alpha_off = i * bpp + 6
626	      out[alpha_off] = img.data[alpha_off]
627	      out[alpha_off + 1] = img.data[alpha_off + 1]
628	    }
629	  }
630	  @types.Image16::{
631	    width: w,
632	    height: h,
633	    channels: ch,
634	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),
635	  }
636	}

 42	      gray[i] = (r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) / 1000
 43	    }
 44	  }
 45	  // 复制 markers
 46	  let labels : Array[Int32] = Array::make(n, 0)
 47	  for i in 0..<n {
 48	    labels[i] = markers[i]
 49	  }
 50	  // 沉浸式分水岭：按灰度值从低到高处理
 51	  // 创建像素索引按灰度值排序的列表
 52	  let indices : Array[Int32] = Array::make(n, 0)
 53	  for i in 0..<n {
 54	    indices[i] = i
 55	  }
 56	  // 按灰度值排序（基数排序，0-255）
 57	  let sorted : Array[Array[Int32]] = Array::make(256, [])
 58	  for i in 0..<256 {
 59	    sorted[i] = []
 60	  }
 61	  for i in 0..<n {
 62	    sorted[gray[i]].push(i)
 63	  }
 64	  // FIFO 队列
 65	  let wshed = -1 // 分水岭线标记
 66	  let mut current_label = 0
 67	  for i in 0..<n {
 68	    if labels[i] > current_label {
 69	      current_label = labels[i]
 70	    }
 71	  }
 72	  // 按灰度级别处理
 73	  for level in 0..<256 {
 74	    let queue : Array[Int32] = []
 75	    // 将当前级别的已标记像素加入队列
 76	    for idx in sorted[level] {
 77	      // 检查邻居是否有已标记的
 78	      let x = idx % w
 79	      let y = idx / w
 80	      let mut has_labeled_neighbor = false
 81	      for dy in -1..<=1 {
 82	        for dx in -1..<=1 {
 83	          if dx == 0 && dy == 0 {
 84	            continue
 85	          }
 86	          let nx = x + dx
 87	          let ny = y + dy
 88	          if nx >= 0 && nx < w && ny >= 0 && ny < h {
 89	            let nidx = ny * w + nx
 90	            if labels[nidx] > 0 || labels[nidx] == wshed {
 91	              has_labeled_neighbor = true
 92	              break
 93	            }
 94	          }
 95	        }
 96	        if has_labeled_neighbor {
 97	          break
 98	        }
 99	      }
100	      if has_labeled_neighbor {
101	        queue.push(idx)
102	      }
103	    }
104	    // BFS 扩展（head 指针队列，O(1) dequeue 避免 remove(0) 的 O(n) 移压）
105	    let mut q_head = 0
106	    while q_head < queue.length() {
107	      let idx = queue[q_head]
108	      q_head += 1
109	      let x = idx % w
110	      let y = idx / w
111	      let mut label = 0
112	      let mut is_wshed = false
113	      // 查看邻居标签
114	      for dy in -1..<=1 {
115	        for dx in -1..<=1 {
116	          if dx == 0 && dy == 0 {
117	            continue
118	          }
119	          let nx = x + dx
120	          let ny = y + dy
121	          if nx >= 0 && nx < w && ny >= 0 && ny < h {
122	            let nidx = ny * w + nx
123	            let nl = labels[nidx]
124	            if nl > 0 {
125	              if label == 0 {
126	                label = nl
127	              } else if label != nl {
128	                is_wshed = true
129	              }
130	            }
131	          }
132	        }
133	      }
134	      if is_wshed {
135	        labels[idx] = wshed
136	      } else if label > 0 {
137	        labels[idx] = label
138	        // 将同级别未标记邻居加入队列
139	        for dy in -1..<=1 {
140	          for dx in -1..<=1 {
141	            if dx == 0 && dy == 0 {
142	              continue
143	            }
144	            let nx = x + dx
145	            let ny = y + dy
146	            if nx >= 0 && nx < w && ny >= 0 && ny < h {
147	              let nidx = ny * w + nx
148	              if labels[nidx] == 0 && gray[nidx] == level {
149	                labels[nidx] = -2 // 临时标记，在队列中
150	                queue.push(nidx)
151	              }
152	            }
153	          }
154	        }
155	      }
156	    }
157	    // 清除临时标记
158	    for idx in sorted[level] {
159	      if labels[idx] == -2 {
160	        labels[idx] = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
161	      }
162	    }
163	  }
164	  labels

171	pub fn watershed_auto(
172	  img : @types.Image,

191	    } else {

193	      let g = img.data[i * ch + 1].to_int()

214	            let nidx = ny * w + nx

216	              is_min = false
217	              break
218	            }
219	          }
220	        }
221	        if !is_min {

231	        while sp < stack.length() {

233	          sp += 1
234	          let px = pidx % w
235	          let py = pidx / w
236	          for dy in -1..<=1 {
237	            for dx in -1..<=1 {

239	                continue
240	              }
241	              let nx = px + dx
242	              let ny = py + dy
243	              if nx >= 0 && nx < w && ny >= 0 && ny < h {
244	                let nidx = ny * w + nx

247	                  stack.push(nidx)
248	                }
249	              }
250	            }
251	          }
252	        }

254	    }

182	pub fn optical_flow_interpolate(
183	  frame1 : @types.Image,
184	  frame2 : @types.Image,
185	  num_frames : Int32,
186	  config : FrameInterpConfig,
187	) -> Array[@types.Image] {
188	  let result : Array[@types.Image] = []
189	  let w = frame1.width
190	  let h = frame1.height
191	  let ch = frame1.channels
192	  let motion = compute_motion_between_frames(frame1, frame2)
193	  let (dx, dy) = motion.dominant_direction
194	  for k in 1..<=num_frames {
195	    let alpha = k.to_double() / (num_frames + 1).to_double()
196	    let data : Array[Byte] = []
197	    for y in 0..<h {
198	      for x in 0..<w {
199	        let src_x = x.to_double() - dx * alpha
200	        let src_y = y.to_double() - dy * alpha
201	        let x0 = src_x.to_int()
202	        let y0 = src_y.to_int()
203	        let x1 = if x0 + 1 < w { x0 + 1 } else { x0 }
204	        let y1 = if y0 + 1 < h { y0 + 1 } else { y0 }
205	        let cx = src_x - x0.to_double()
206	        let cy = src_y - y0.to_double()
207	        for c in 0..<ch {
208	          let v00 = if x0 >= 0 && y0 >= 0 && x0 < w && y0 < h {
209	            frame1.data[(y0 * w + x0) * ch + c].to_double()
210	          } else {
211	            0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
212	          }
213	          let v01 = if x1 >= 0 && y0 >= 0 && x1 < w && y0 < h {
214	            frame1.data[(y0 * w + x1) * ch + c].to_double()
215	          } else {
216	            0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
217	          }
218	          let v10 = if x0 >= 0 && y1 >= 0 && x0 < w && y1 < h {
219	            frame1.data[(y1 * w + x0) * ch + c].to_double()
220	          } else {
221	            0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
222	          }
223	          let v11 = if x1 >= 0 && y1 >= 0 && x1 < w && y1 < h {
224	            frame1.data[(y1 * w + x1) * ch + c].to_double()
225	          } else {
226	            0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
227	          }
228	          let warped = v00 * (1.0 - cx) * (1.0 - cy) +
229	            v01 * cx * (1.0 - cy) +
230	            v10 * (1.0 - cx) * cy +
231	            v11 * cx * cy
232	          let v2 = frame2.data[(y * w + x) * ch + c].to_double()

243	    }

286	pub fn hsv_to_rgb(
287	  h : Float,
288	  s : Float,
289	  v : Float,
290	) -> (Int32, Int32, Int32) raise @types.LoadError {

294	      "hsv_to_rgb: s,v必须在[0,1]范围内",
295	    )
296	  }

311	  } else {

320	  } else if hp < 3.0F {
321	    (0.0F, c, x)
322	  } else if hp < 4.0F {
323	    (0.0F, x, c)
324	  } else if hp < 5.0F {
325	    (x, 0.0F, c)
326	  } else {
327	    (c, 0.0F, x)
328	  }
329	  (
330	    ((r1 + m) * 255.0F + 0.5F).to_int(),
331	    ((g1 + m) * 255.0F + 0.5F).to_int(),

160	fn patch_distance_inner(
161	  pixels : Array[Int32],
162	  x1 : Int32,
163	  y1 : Int32,
164	  x2 : Int32,
165	  y2 : Int32,
166	  w : Int32,
167	  ch : Int32,
168	  c : Int32,
169	  patch_d : Int32,
170	  early_term : Int32,
171	) -> Int32 {
172	  let mut dist = 0
173	  for dy in -patch_d..<=patch_d {
174	    let row1 = (y1 + dy) * w
175	    let row2 = (y2 + dy) * w
176	    for dx in -patch_d..<=patch_d {
177	      let v1 = pixels[(row1 + x1 + dx) * ch + c]
178	      let v2 = pixels[(row2 + x2 + dx) * ch + c]
179	      let diff = v1 - v2
180	      dist += diff * diff
181	      if dist >= early_term {
182	        return dist	<-- UNCOVERED
183	      }
184	    }
185	  }
186	  dist
187	}

260	pub fn nlm_denoise_fast(
261	  img : @types.Image,
262	  patch_size~ : Int32 = 3,
263	  search_size~ : Int32 = 7,
264	  h~ : Int32 = 10,
265	  step~ : Int32 = 2,
266	) -> @types.Image raise @types.LoadError {

271	    )
272	  }

289	  }

291	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("search_size 必须在 1..20 之间")	<-- UNCOVERED
292	  }
293	  if h < 1 {
294	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("h 必须 >= 1")	<-- UNCOVERED
295	  }
296	  if step < 1 || step > 5 {
297	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("step 必须在 1..5 之间")
298	  }

303	  if n == 0 {

317	  let early_term = (denom * 6.907755278982137F).to_int()

320	  for y in inner_start..<(h_img - inner_start) {

359	  }

363	    for x in 0..<w {

365	        continue
366	      }

444	fn to_grayscale_ocr(img : @types.Image) -> @types.Image {
445	  if img.channels == 1 {
446	    return img	<-- UNCOVERED
447	  }
448	  let n = img.width * img.height
449	  let ch = img.channels
450	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n, b'\x00')
451	  let data = img.data
452	  for i in 0..<n {

456	    let b = data[base + 2].to_int()

261	pub fn detect_flicker(
262	  frames : Array[@types.Image],
263	  threshold : Double,
264	) -> FlickerDetection {
265	  let n = frames.length()
266	  if n < 2 {
267	    return { has_flicker: false, flicker_score: 0.0, frame_indices: [], }	<-- UNCOVERED
268	  }

274	  for i in 1..<n {
275	    mean_diff = mean_diff + (luminances[i] - luminances[i - 1]).abs()
276	  }
277	  mean_diff = mean_diff / (n - 1).to_double()
278	  let flicker_indices : Array[Int32] = []
279	  for i in 1..<n {

283	    }
284	  }

286	  {

289	    frame_indices: flicker_indices,

100	fn Vp8BoolDecoder::read_bool(self : Vp8BoolDecoder, prob : Int32) -> Int32 {
101	  // VP8 布尔解码器核心算法
102	  let split = 1 + (((self.range - 1) * prob) >> 8)	<-- UNCOVERED

104	  let mut bit = 0

109	  } else {

111	  }
112	  // 归一化

245	fn Vp8AdaptiveProbs::update(self : Vp8AdaptiveProbs) -> Unit {
246	  self.total_blocks += 1	<-- UNCOVERED
247	  // 每 8 个块更新一次概率（减少计算量）

253	  for i in 0..<16 {

255	    // 更新零系数概率

258	      self.prob_zero[i] = (self.prob_zero[i] * 7 + observed_zero) / 8

262	    if non_zero > 0 {

264	      self.prob_one[i] = (self.prob_one[i] * 7 + observed_one) / 8

270	      self.prob_eob[i] = (self.prob_eob[i] * 7 + observed_eob) / 8
271	    }
272	    // 更新额外位概率
273	    let extra_total = self.count_extra[i] + 1
274	    if extra_total > 0 {
275	      let observed_extra = self.count_extra[i] * 256 / extra_total	<-- UNCOVERED
276	      self.prob_extra[i] = (self.prob_extra[i] * 7 + observed_extra) / 8
277	    }
278	  }
279	
280	  // 更新符号概率

287	  // 重置计数器（保留部分历史）

362	fn vp8_parse_residual_4x4(
363	  bd : Vp8BoolDecoder,
364	  probs : Vp8AdaptiveProbs,
365	  is_dc : Bool,
366	) -> Array[Int32] {
367	  ignore(is_dc)	<-- UNCOVERED
368	  let coeffs = Array::make(16, 0)
369	  let zigzag = vp8_zigzag_4x4()
370	  let mut eob = false // end of block
371	  for i in 0..<16 {
372	    if eob {	<-- UNCOVERED
373	      break
374	    }
375	    let pos = zigzag[i]
376	    // 使用自适应概率解析 base token
377	    let zero_prob = probs.get_zero_prob(i)	<-- UNCOVERED
378	    let is_zero = bd.read_bool(zero_prob) == 1
379	    if is_zero {
380	      probs.record_zero(i)	<-- UNCOVERED
381	      // 检查是否是 EOB（块结束）
382	      if i > 0 {
383	        let eob_prob = probs.get_eob_prob(i)	<-- UNCOVERED
384	        let is_eob = bd.read_bool(eob_prob) == 1
385	        if is_eob {
386	          probs.record_eob(i)	<-- UNCOVERED
387	          eob = true
388	        }
389	      }
390	      continue
391	    }
392	    // 非零系数：解析符号和值
393	    let one_prob = probs.get_one_prob(i)	<-- UNCOVERED
394	    let is_one = bd.read_bool(one_prob) == 1
395	    let mut value = 0
396	    if is_one {
397	      probs.record_one(i)	<-- UNCOVERED
398	      value = 1
399	    } else {
400	      // 解析额外位
401	      let extra_prob = probs.get_extra_prob(i)	<-- UNCOVERED
402	      probs.record_extra(i)
403	      let mut extra = 1
404	      let mut continue_read = true
405	      while continue_read {
406	        let read_more = bd.read_bool(extra_prob) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
407	        if read_more {
408	          extra = (extra << 1) | bd.read_bool(128)	<-- UNCOVERED
409	          if extra > 2047 {
410	            continue_read = false	<-- UNCOVERED
411	          }
412	        } else {
413	          continue_read = false	<-- UNCOVERED
414	        }
415	      }
416	      value = extra + 1
417	    }
418	    // 解析符号（使用自适应符号概率）
419	    let sign = bd.read_bool(probs.prob_sign)	<-- UNCOVERED
420	    let is_positive = sign == 0
421	    probs.record_sign(is_positive)	<-- UNCOVERED
422	    if !is_positive {
423	      value = -value	<-- UNCOVERED
424	    }
425	    coeffs[pos] = value
426	  }
427	  // 更新自适应概率
428	  probs.update()	<-- UNCOVERED
429	  coeffs
430	}

676	    Vp8QuantParams::{ y_ac: delta, y_dc: delta, uv_ac: delta, uv_dc: delta, }	<-- UNCOVERED
677	  }
678	}
   	…

682	fn vp8_get_filter_level_for_segment(
683	  base_level : Int32,
684	  segment : Vp8SegmentParams,
685	  segment_id : Int32,
686	) -> Int32 {
687	  if !segment.enabled || segment_id < 0 || segment_id >= 4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
688	    return base_level
689	  }
690	  let delta = segment.filter_deltas[segment_id]
691	  let mut level = if segment.feature_mode == 0 {
692	    base_level + delta	<-- UNCOVERED
693	  } else {
694	    delta	<-- UNCOVERED
695	  }
696	  if level < 0 {
697	    level = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
698	  }
699	  if level > 63 {
700	    level = 63	<-- UNCOVERED
701	  }
702	  level
703	}

712	fn vp8_idct_4x4(block : Array[Int32]) -> Array[Int32] {
713	  let result = Array::make(16, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
714	  // 行变换（一维 IDCT）
715	  for i in 0..<4 {
716	    let a0 = block[i * 4]	<-- UNCOVERED
717	    let a1 = block[i * 4 + 1]
718	    let a2 = block[i * 4 + 2]
719	    let a3 = block[i * 4 + 3]
720	    // VP8 一维 IDCT（使用 c=85627, c*sqrt(2)=121095）
721	    let b0 = a0 * 85627 + a2 * 85627
722	    let b1 = a0 * 85627 - a2 * 85627
723	    let b2 = a1 * 53527 - a3 * 22109
724	    let b3 = a1 * 22109 + a3 * 53527
725	    result[i * 4] = (b0 + b3) >> 17
726	    result[i * 4 + 1] = (b1 + b2) >> 17
727	    result[i * 4 + 2] = (b1 - b2) >> 17
728	    result[i * 4 + 3] = (b0 - b3) >> 17
729	  }
730	  // 列变换（一维 IDCT）
731	  let temp = Array::make(16, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
732	  for i in 0..<16 {
733	    temp[i] = result[i]	<-- UNCOVERED
734	  }
735	  for j in 0..<4 {
736	    let a0 = temp[j]	<-- UNCOVERED
737	    let a1 = temp[4 + j]
738	    let a2 = temp[8 + j]
739	    let a3 = temp[12 + j]
740	    let b0 = a0 * 85627 + a2 * 85627
741	    let b1 = a0 * 85627 - a2 * 85627
742	    let b2 = a1 * 53527 - a3 * 22109
743	    let b3 = a1 * 22109 + a3 * 53527
744	    result[j] = (b0 + b3) >> 17
745	    result[4 + j] = (b1 + b2) >> 17
746	    result[8 + j] = (b1 - b2) >> 17
747	    result[12 + j] = (b0 - b3) >> 17
748	  }
749	  result
750	}
   	…

756	fn vp8_wht_4x4(block : Array[Int32]) -> Array[Int32] {
757	  let result = Array::make(16, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
758	  // 行变换
759	  for i in 0..<4 {
760	    let a0 = block[i * 4]	<-- UNCOVERED
761	    let a1 = block[i * 4 + 1]
762	    let a2 = block[i * 4 + 2]
763	    let a3 = block[i * 4 + 3]
764	    let b0 = a0 + a1
765	    let b1 = a0 - a1
766	    let b2 = a2 + a3
767	    let b3 = a2 - a3
768	    result[i * 4] = b0 + b2
769	    result[i * 4 + 1] = b1 + b3
770	    result[i * 4 + 2] = b1 - b3
771	    result[i * 4 + 3] = b0 - b2
772	  }
773	  // 列变换
774	  let temp = Array::make(16, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
775	  for i in 0..<16 {
776	    temp[i] = result[i]	<-- UNCOVERED
777	  }
778	  for j in 0..<4 {
779	    let a0 = temp[j]	<-- UNCOVERED
780	    let a1 = temp[4 + j]
781	    let a2 = temp[8 + j]
782	    let a3 = temp[12 + j]
783	    let b0 = a0 + a1
784	    let b1 = a0 - a1
785	    let b2 = a2 + a3
786	    let b3 = a2 - a3
787	    result[j] = (b0 + b2) >> 1
788	    result[4 + j] = (b1 + b3) >> 1
789	    result[8 + j] = (b1 - b3) >> 1
790	    result[12 + j] = (b0 - b2) >> 1
791	  }
792	  result
793	}

827	fn vp8_intra_predict_16x16(
828	  mode : Vp8I16x16Mode,
829	  above : Array[Int32],
830	  left : Array[Int32],
831	  above_left : Int32,
832	) -> Array[Int32] {
833	  let result = Array::make(256, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
834	  match mode {
835	    I16x16DcPred => {
836	      let mut sum = above_left * 2
837	      for i in 0..<16 {
838	        sum += above[i]	<-- UNCOVERED
839	        sum += left[i]
840	      }
841	      let dc = (sum + 16) >> 5
842	      for i in 0..<256 {
843	        result[i] = dc	<-- UNCOVERED
844	      }
845	    }
846	    I16x16TrueMotionPred =>
847	      for y in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
848	        for x in 0..<16 {
849	          let mut sum = 0
850	          for i in 0..<(x + 1) {
851	            sum += above[i]	<-- UNCOVERED
852	          }
853	          for i in 0..<(y + 1) {
854	            sum += left[i]	<-- UNCOVERED
855	          }
856	          sum += above_left
857	          result[y * 16 + x] = (sum + (x + y + 2) / 2) / (x + y + 2)
858	        }
859	      }
860	    I16x16HPred =>
861	      for y in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
862	        for x in 0..<16 {
863	          result[y * 16 + x] = left[y]
864	        }
865	      }
866	    I16x16VPred =>
867	      for y in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
868	        for x in 0..<16 {
869	          result[y * 16 + x] = above[x]
870	        }
871	      }
872	  }
873	  result
874	}

 888	fn _vp8_intra_predict_4x4(
 889	  mode : Vp8I4x4Mode,
 890	  above : Array[Int32],
 891	  left : Array[Int32],
 892	  above_left : Int32,
 893	) -> Array[Int32] {
 894	  let result = Array::make(16, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
 895	  match mode {
 896	    // 0: DC 预测 - 上方和左方像素的平均值
 897	    I4x4DcPred => {	<-- UNCOVERED
 898	      let mut sum = 0
 899	      for i in 0..<4 {
 900	        sum += above[i]	<-- UNCOVERED
 901	        sum += left[i]
 902	      }
 903	      let dc = (sum + 4) >> 3
 904	      for i in 0..<16 {
 905	        result[i] = dc	<-- UNCOVERED
 906	      }
 907	    }
 908	
 909	    // 1: TrueMotion 预测 - 基于水平和垂直梯度
 910	    // P[y][x] = clip(above[x] + left[y] - above_left, 0, 255)
 911	    I4x4TrueMotionPred =>
 912	      for y in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
 913	        for x in 0..<4 {
 914	          let mut pred = above[x] + left[y] - above_left
 915	          if pred < 0 {
 916	            pred = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
 917	          }
 918	          if pred > 255 {
 919	            pred = 255	<-- UNCOVERED
 920	          }
 921	          result[y * 4 + x] = pred
 922	        }
 923	      }
 924	
 925	    // 2: 水平预测 - 使用左方像素
 926	    // P[y][x] = left[y]
 927	    I4x4HPred =>
 928	      for y in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
 929	        for x in 0..<4 {
 930	          result[y * 4 + x] = left[y]
 931	        }
 932	      }
 933	
 934	    // 3: 垂直预测 - 使用上方像素
 935	    // P[y][x] = above[x]
 936	    I4x4VPred =>
 937	      for y in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
 938	        for x in 0..<4 {
 939	          result[y * 4 + x] = above[x]
 940	        }
 941	      }
 942	
 943	    // 4: LeftDown 预测（左下/对角线，斜率 1）
 944	    // 从左上到右下的对角线预测
 945	    // P[y][x] = (above[x+y] + above[x+y+1] + 1) >> 1  (x+y <= 6)
 946	    // P[y][x] = above[7]  (x+y == 7)
 947	    I4x4LeftDownPred =>
 948	      for y in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
 949	        for x in 0..<4 {
 950	          let idx = x + y
 951	          if idx <= 6 {
 952	            result[y * 4 + x] = (above[idx] + above[idx + 1] + 1) >> 1	<-- UNCOVERED
 953	          } else {
 954	            result[y * 4 + x] = above[7]	<-- UNCOVERED
 955	          }
 956	        }
 957	      }
 958	
 959	    // 5: RightDown 预测（右下/对角线，斜率 -1）
 960	    // 从右上到左下的对角线预测
 961	    // 如果 x >= y: P[y][x] = (above[x-y] + above[x-y+1] + 1) >> 1
 962	    // 如果 x < y:  P[y][x] = (left[y-x-1] + left[y-x] + 1) >> 1
 963	    I4x4RightDownPred =>
 964	      for y in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
 965	        for x in 0..<4 {
 966	          if x >= y {
 967	            let idx = x - y
 968	            result[y * 4 + x] = (above[idx] + above[idx + 1] + 1) >> 1
 969	          } else {
 970	            let idx = y - x - 1	<-- UNCOVERED
 971	            result[y * 4 + x] = (left[idx] + left[idx + 1] + 1) >> 1
 972	          }
 973	        }
 974	      }
 975	
 976	    // 6: RightUp 预测（右上/垂直-右组合）
 977	    // 垂直预测为主，向右下方倾斜
 978	    // P[y][x] = (above[x] + above[x+1] + left[y] + 1) >> 2
 979	    I4x4RightUpPred =>
 980	      for y in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
 981	        for x in 0..<4 {
 982	          result[y * 4 + x] = (above[x] + above[x + 1] + left[y] + 1) >> 2
 983	        }
 984	      }
 985	
 986	    // 7: LeftUp 预测（左上/水平-上组合）
 987	    // 水平预测为主，向右上方倾斜
 988	    // P[y][x] = (left[y] + left[y+1] + above[x] + 1) >> 2
 989	    I4x4LeftUpPred =>
 990	      for y in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
 991	        for x in 0..<4 {
 992	          result[y * 4 + x] = (left[y] + left[y + 1] + above[x] + 1) >> 2
 993	        }
 994	      }
 995	
 996	    // 8: VertRight 预测（垂直-右）
 997	    // 垂直预测 + 对角线修正
 998	    // P[y][x] = (above[x] + above[x+1] + 1) >> 1  (y == 0)
 999	    // P[y][x] = (above[x] + left[y-1] + 1) >> 1    (y > 0)
1000	    I4x4VertRightPred =>
1001	      for y in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1002	        for x in 0..<4 {
1003	          if y == 0 {
1004	            result[y * 4 + x] = (above[x] + above[x + 1] + 1) >> 1
1005	          } else {
1006	            result[y * 4 + x] = (above[x] + left[y - 1] + 1) >> 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1007	          }
1008	        }
1009	      }
1010	
1011	    // 9: HorizDown 预测（水平-下）
1012	    // 水平预测 + 对角线修正
1013	    // P[y][x] = (left[y] + left[y+1] + 1) >> 1  (x == 0)
1014	    // P[y][x] = (left[y] + above[x-1] + 1) >> 1  (x > 0)
1015	    I4x4HorizDownPred =>
1016	      for y in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1017	        for x in 0..<4 {
1018	          if x == 0 {
1019	            result[y * 4 + x] = (left[y] + left[y + 1] + 1) >> 1
1020	          } else {
1021	            result[y * 4 + x] = (left[y] + above[x - 1] + 1) >> 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1022	          }
1023	        }
1024	      }
1025	  }
1026	  result
1027	}

1069	fn vp8_parse_i16x16_mode(
1070	  bd : Vp8BoolDecoder,
1071	  probs : Vp8MbModeProbs,
1072	) -> Vp8I16x16Mode {
1073	  // 使用概率模型解析预测模式
1074	  // VP8 使用树形概率解析：先判断是否是 DC，然后判断剩余模式
1075	  let is_dc = bd.read_bool(probs.i16x16_prob[0]) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1076	  if is_dc {
1077	    probs.i16x16_count[0] += 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1078	    return Vp8I16x16Mode::I16x16DcPred
1079	  }
1080	  let is_tm = bd.read_bool(probs.i16x16_prob[1]) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1081	  if is_tm {
1082	    probs.i16x16_count[1] += 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1083	    return Vp8I16x16Mode::I16x16TrueMotionPred
1084	  }
1085	  let is_h = bd.read_bool(probs.i16x16_prob[2]) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1086	  if is_h {
1087	    probs.i16x16_count[2] += 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1088	    return Vp8I16x16Mode::I16x16HPred
1089	  }
1090	  probs.i16x16_count[3] += 1
1091	  Vp8I16x16Mode::I16x16VPred
1092	}

1096	fn _vp8_parse_i4x4_mode(

1188	fn Vp8MbModeProbs::update(self : Vp8MbModeProbs) -> Unit {
1189	  self.total_mbs += 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1190	  // 每 16 个宏块更新一次概率
1191	  if self.total_mbs % 16 != 0 {
1192	    return	<-- UNCOVERED
1193	  }
1194	
1195	  // 更新 I16x16 概率
1196	  let i16_total = self.i16x16_count[0] +
1197	    self.i16x16_count[1] +
1198	    self.i16x16_count[2] +
1199	    self.i16x16_count[3] +
1200	    1
1201	  for i in 0..<4 {
1202	    let observed = self.i16x16_count[i] * 256 / i16_total	<-- UNCOVERED
1203	    self.i16x16_prob[i] = (self.i16x16_prob[i] * 7 + observed) / 8
1204	    self.i16x16_count[i] = self.i16x16_count[i] / 2
1205	  }
1206	
1207	  // 更新 I4x4 概率
1208	  let i4_total = self.i4x4_count[0] +
1209	    self.i4x4_count[1] +
1210	    self.i4x4_count[2] +
1211	    self.i4x4_count[3] +
1212	    self.i4x4_count[4] +
1213	    self.i4x4_count[5] +
1214	    self.i4x4_count[6] +
1215	    self.i4x4_count[7] +
1216	    self.i4x4_count[8] +
1217	    self.i4x4_count[9] +
1218	    1
1219	  for i in 0..<10 {
1220	    let observed = self.i4x4_count[i] * 256 / i4_total	<-- UNCOVERED
1221	    self.i4x4_prob[i] = (self.i4x4_prob[i] * 7 + observed) / 8
1222	    self.i4x4_count[i] = self.i4x4_count[i] / 2
1223	  }
1224	
1225	  // 更新 UV 概率
1226	  let uv_total = self.uv_count[0] +
1227	    self.uv_count[1] +
1228	    self.uv_count[2] +
1229	    self.uv_count[3] +
1230	    1
1231	  for i in 0..<4 {
1232	    let observed = self.uv_count[i] * 256 / uv_total	<-- UNCOVERED
1233	    self.uv_prob[i] = (self.uv_prob[i] * 7 + observed) / 8
1234	    self.uv_count[i] = self.uv_count[i] / 2
1235	  }
1236	
1237	  // 更新子宏块类型概率
1238	  let submb_total = self.total_mbs + 1
1239	  let observed_submb = self.submb_type_count * 256 / submb_total
1240	  self.submb_type_prob = (self.submb_type_prob * 7 + observed_submb) / 8
1241	  self.submb_type_count = self.submb_type_count / 2
1242	}

1271	fn _vp8_calc_filter_level(
1272	  params : Vp8LoopFilterParams,
1273	  segment_id : Int32,
1274	  is_i16x16 : Bool,
1275	) -> Int32 {
1276	  let mut level = params.filter_level	<-- UNCOVERED
1277	  // 加上 segment 增量
1278	  if segment_id >= 0 && segment_id < 4 {
1279	    level += params.segment_deltas[segment_id]	<-- UNCOVERED
1280	  }
1281	  // 加上模式/参考帧增量（I16x16 使用第一个增量）
1282	  if is_i16x16 {
1283	    level += params.mode_ref_deltas[0]	<-- UNCOVERED
1284	  } else {
1285	    level += params.mode_ref_deltas[1]	<-- UNCOVERED
1286	  }
1287	  // 限制范围
1288	  if level < 0 {
1289	    level = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1290	  }
1291	  if level > 63 {
1292	    level = 63	<-- UNCOVERED
1293	  }
1294	  level
1295	}

1300	fn vp8_filter_vertical_4(
1301	  plane : Array[Int32],
1302	  x : Int32,
1303	  y : Int32,
1304	  width : Int32,
1305	  filter_level : Int32,
1306	  inner_level : Int32,
1307	) -> Unit {
1308	  if x <= 0 || x >= width {	<-- UNCOVERED
1309	    return
1310	  }
1311	  let idx = y * width + x
1312	  let p1 = plane[idx - 2]
1313	  let p0 = plane[idx - 1]
1314	  let q0 = plane[idx]
1315	  let q1 = plane[idx + 1]
1316	
1317	  // 检查是否需要滤波
1318	  let threshold = filter_level * 2
1319	  if (p0 - q0).abs() * 2 + (p1 - q1).abs() / 2 > threshold {	<-- UNCOVERED
1320	    return
1321	  }
1322	
1323	  // 计算滤波值
1324	  let mut p0_new = p0
1325	  let mut q0_new = q0
1326	  let mut p1_new = p1
1327	  let mut q1_new = q1
1328	
1329	  if filter_level > 0 {
1330	    // 简单的 4 抽头滤波
1331	    let filter_val = (p1 + 2 * p0 + 2 * q0 + q1 + 4) / 8	<-- UNCOVERED
1332	    p0_new = filter_val
1333	    q0_new = filter_val
1334	
1335	    // 如果内部滤波级别足够，也滤波 p1 和 q1
1336	    if inner_level > 0 && (p1 - p0).abs() < inner_level {	<-- UNCOVERED
1337	      p1_new = (p1 + p0_new + 1) / 2
1338	    }
1339	    if inner_level > 0 && (q1 - q0).abs() < inner_level {	<-- UNCOVERED
1340	      q1_new = (q1 + q0_new + 1) / 2
1341	    }
1342	  }
1343	
1344	  plane[idx - 2] = p1_new
1345	  plane[idx - 1] = p0_new
1346	  plane[idx] = q0_new
1347	  plane[idx + 1] = q1_new
1348	}
    	…

1352	fn vp8_filter_horizontal_4(
1353	  plane : Array[Int32],
1354	  x : Int32,
1355	  y : Int32,
1356	  width : Int32,
1357	  filter_level : Int32,
1358	  inner_level : Int32,
1359	) -> Unit {
1360	  if y <= 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1361	    return
1362	  }
1363	  let idx = y * width + x
1364	  let p1 = plane[idx - 2 * width]
1365	  let p0 = plane[idx - width]
1366	  let q0 = plane[idx]
1367	  let q1 = plane[idx + width]
1368	
1369	  // 检查是否需要滤波
1370	  let threshold = filter_level * 2
1371	  if (p0 - q0).abs() * 2 + (p1 - q1).abs() / 2 > threshold {	<-- UNCOVERED
1372	    return
1373	  }
1374	
1375	  // 计算滤波值
1376	  let mut p0_new = p0
1377	  let mut q0_new = q0
1378	  let mut p1_new = p1
1379	  let mut q1_new = q1
1380	
1381	  if filter_level > 0 {
1382	    let filter_val = (p1 + 2 * p0 + 2 * q0 + q1 + 4) / 8	<-- UNCOVERED
1383	    p0_new = filter_val
1384	    q0_new = filter_val
1385	
1386	    if inner_level > 0 && (p1 - p0).abs() < inner_level {	<-- UNCOVERED
1387	      p1_new = (p1 + p0_new + 1) / 2
1388	    }
1389	    if inner_level > 0 && (q1 - q0).abs() < inner_level {	<-- UNCOVERED
1390	      q1_new = (q1 + q0_new + 1) / 2
1391	    }
1392	  }
1393	
1394	  plane[idx - 2 * width] = p1_new
1395	  plane[idx - width] = p0_new
1396	  plane[idx] = q0_new
1397	  plane[idx + width] = q1_new
1398	}

1403	fn vp8_loop_filter_mb(
1404	  y_plane : Array[Int32],
1405	  u_plane : Array[Int32],
1406	  v_plane : Array[Int32],
1407	  mb_x : Int32,
1408	  mb_y : Int32,
1409	  width : Int32,
1410	  height : Int32,
1411	  filter_level : Int32,
1412	) -> Unit {
1413	  if filter_level == 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1414	    return
1415	  }
1416	
1417	  let inner_level = filter_level / 2
1418	  let mb_px = mb_x * 16
1419	  let mb_py = mb_y * 16
1420	
1421	  // === Y 平面滤波 ===
1422	
1423	  // 宏块左边界垂直滤波（16行）
1424	  if mb_x > 0 {
1425	    for y in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1426	      let py = mb_py + y
1427	      if py < height {
1428	        vp8_filter_vertical_4(	<-- UNCOVERED
1429	          y_plane, mb_px, py, width, filter_level, inner_level,
1430	        )
1431	      }
1432	    }
1433	  }
1434	
1435	  // 宏块上边界水平滤波（16列）
1436	  if mb_y > 0 {
1437	    for x in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1438	      let px = mb_px + x
1439	      if px < width {
1440	        vp8_filter_horizontal_4(	<-- UNCOVERED
1441	          y_plane, px, mb_py, width, filter_level, inner_level,
1442	        )
1443	      }
1444	    }
1445	  }
1446	
1447	  // 子宏块内部垂直边界滤波（x = 4, 8, 12）
1448	  for sub_x in [4, 8, 12] {
1449	    let px = mb_px + sub_x	<-- UNCOVERED
1450	    if px < width {
1451	      for y in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1452	        let py = mb_py + y
1453	        if py < height {
1454	          vp8_filter_vertical_4(	<-- UNCOVERED
1455	            y_plane,
1456	            px,
1457	            py,
1458	            width,
1459	            inner_level,
1460	            inner_level / 2,
1461	          )
1462	        }
1463	      }
1464	    }
1465	  }
1466	
1467	  // 子宏块内部水平边界滤波（y = 4, 8, 12）
1468	  for sub_y in [4, 8, 12] {
1469	    let py = mb_py + sub_y	<-- UNCOVERED
1470	    if py < height {
1471	      for x in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1472	        let px = mb_px + x
1473	        if px < width {
1474	          vp8_filter_horizontal_4(	<-- UNCOVERED
1475	            y_plane,
1476	            px,
1477	            py,
1478	            width,
1479	            inner_level,
1480	            inner_level / 2,
1481	          )
1482	        }
1483	      }
1484	    }
1485	  }
1486	
1487	  // === 色度平面滤波（U 和 V，8x8 块） ===
1488	  let uv_width = width / 2
1489	  let uv_height = height / 2
1490	  let uv_mb_px = mb_x * 8
1491	  let uv_mb_py = mb_y * 8
1492	
1493	  // U 平面：左边界垂直滤波
1494	  if mb_x > 0 {
1495	    for y in 0..<8 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1496	      let py = uv_mb_py + y
1497	      if py < uv_height {
1498	        vp8_filter_vertical_4(	<-- UNCOVERED
1499	          u_plane,
1500	          uv_mb_px,
1501	          py,
1502	          uv_width,
1503	          filter_level / 2,
1504	          inner_level / 2,
1505	        )
1506	      }
1507	    }
1508	  }
1509	
1510	  // U 平面：上边界水平滤波
1511	  if mb_y > 0 {
1512	    for x in 0..<8 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1513	      let px = uv_mb_px + x
1514	      if px < uv_width {
1515	        vp8_filter_horizontal_4(	<-- UNCOVERED
1516	          u_plane,
1517	          px,
1518	          uv_mb_py,
1519	          uv_width,
1520	          filter_level / 2,
1521	          inner_level / 2,
1522	        )
1523	      }
1524	    }
1525	  }
1526	
1527	  // V 平面：左边界垂直滤波
1528	  if mb_x > 0 {
1529	    for y in 0..<8 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1530	      let py = uv_mb_py + y
1531	      if py < uv_height {
1532	        vp8_filter_vertical_4(	<-- UNCOVERED
1533	          v_plane,
1534	          uv_mb_px,
1535	          py,
1536	          uv_width,
1537	          filter_level / 2,
1538	          inner_level / 2,
1539	        )
1540	      }
1541	    }
1542	  }
1543	
1544	  // V 平面：上边界水平滤波
1545	  if mb_y > 0 {
1546	    for x in 0..<8 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1547	      let px = uv_mb_px + x
1548	      if px < uv_width {
1549	        vp8_filter_horizontal_4(	<-- UNCOVERED
1550	          v_plane,
1551	          px,
1552	          uv_mb_py,
1553	          uv_width,
1554	          filter_level / 2,
1555	          inner_level / 2,
1556	        )
1557	      }
1558	    }
1559	  }
1560	}

1637	fn _vp8_motion_compensate_16x16(
1638	  ref_y : Array[Int32],
1639	  ref_u : Array[Int32],
1640	  ref_v : Array[Int32],
1641	  mb_x : Int32,
1642	  mb_y : Int32,
1643	  mv : Vp8MotionVector,
1644	  width : Int32,
1645	  height : Int32,
1646	) -> (Array[Int32], Array[Int32], Array[Int32]) {
1647	  let pred_y = Array::make(256, 128) // 16x16 = 256	<-- UNCOVERED
1648	  let pred_u = Array::make(64, 128) // 8x8 = 64
1649	  let pred_v = Array::make(64, 128) // 8x8 = 64
1650	
1651	  // 计算参考位置（加上运动向量）
1652	  let ref_x = mb_x * 16 + mv.mv_x
1653	  let ref_y_pos = mb_y * 16 + mv.mv_y
1654	
1655	  // Y 平面运动补偿（16x16）
1656	  for y in 0..<16 {
1657	    for x in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1658	      let sx = ref_x + x
1659	      let sy = ref_y_pos + y
1660	      // 边界钳制
1661	      let cx = if sx < 0 { 0 } else if sx >= width { width - 1 } else { sx }	<-- UNCOVERED
1662	      let cy = if sy < 0 { 0 } else if sy >= height { height - 1 } else { sy }
1663	      pred_y[y * 16 + x] = ref_y[cy * width + cx]
1664	    }
1665	  }
1666	
1667	  // U/V 平面运动补偿（8x8，运动向量减半）
1668	  let uv_width = width / 2
1669	  let uv_height = height / 2
1670	  let uv_ref_x = (ref_x + 1) / 2
1671	  let uv_ref_y = (ref_y_pos + 1) / 2
1672	  for y in 0..<8 {
1673	    for x in 0..<8 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1674	      let sx = uv_ref_x + x
1675	      let sy = uv_ref_y + y
1676	      let cx = if sx < 0 {
1677	        0	<-- UNCOVERED
1678	      } else if sx >= uv_width {
1679	        uv_width - 1
1680	      } else {
1681	        sx	<-- UNCOVERED
1682	      }
1683	      let cy = if sy < 0 {
1684	        0	<-- UNCOVERED
1685	      } else if sy >= uv_height {
1686	        uv_height - 1
1687	      } else {
1688	        sy	<-- UNCOVERED
1689	      }
1690	      pred_u[y * 8 + x] = ref_u[cy * uv_width + cx]
1691	      pred_v[y * 8 + x] = ref_v[cy * uv_width + cx]
1692	    }
1693	  }
1694	
1695	  (pred_y, pred_u, pred_v)
1696	}

1701	fn vp8_interpolate_6tap(
1702	  p0 : Int32,
1703	  p1 : Int32,
1704	  p2 : Int32,
1705	  p3 : Int32,
1706	  p4 : Int32,
1707	  p5 : Int32,
1708	) -> Int32 {
1709	  let sum = p0 - 5 * p1 + 20 * p2 + 20 * p3 - 5 * p4 + p5	<-- UNCOVERED
1710	  let result = (sum + 32) >> 6
1711	  if result < 0 {
1712	    0	<-- UNCOVERED
1713	  } else if result > 255 {
1714	    255
1715	  } else {
1716	    result	<-- UNCOVERED
1717	  }
1718	}
    	…

1722	fn vp8_get_ref_pixel(
1723	  ref_plane : Array[Int32],
1724	  x : Int32,
1725	  y : Int32,
1726	  width : Int32,
1727	  height : Int32,
1728	) -> Int32 {
1729	  let cx = if x < 0 { 0 } else if x >= width { width - 1 } else { x }	<-- UNCOVERED
1730	  let cy = if y < 0 { 0 } else if y >= height { height - 1 } else { y }
1731	  ref_plane[cy * width + cx]
1732	}
    	…

1737	fn vp8_interpolate_subpixel(
1738	  ref_plane : Array[Int32],
1739	  base_x : Int32,
1740	  base_y : Int32,
1741	  mv_x_q4 : Int32,
1742	  mv_y_q4 : Int32,
1743	  width : Int32,
1744	  height : Int32,
1745	) -> Int32 {
1746	  // 整数部分和小数部分
1747	  let int_x = mv_x_q4 >> 2	<-- UNCOVERED
1748	  let frac_x = mv_x_q4 & 3
1749	  let int_y = mv_y_q4 >> 2
1750	  let frac_y = mv_y_q4 & 3
1751	
1752	  let px = base_x + int_x
1753	  let py = base_y + int_y
1754	
1755	  // 如果是整数像素，直接返回
1756	  if frac_x == 0 && frac_y == 0 {
1757	    return vp8_get_ref_pixel(ref_plane, px, py, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
1758	  }
1759	
1760	  // 半像素插值（使用 6 抽头滤波器）
1761	  // 先进行水平插值得到半像素
1762	  let h_samples : Array[Int32] = Array::make(6, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
1763	  for i in 0..<6 {
1764	    h_samples[i] = vp8_get_ref_pixel(ref_plane, px - 2 + i, py, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
1765	  }
1766	  let half_x = if frac_x >= 2 {
1767	    vp8_interpolate_6tap(	<-- UNCOVERED
1768	      h_samples[0],
1769	      h_samples[1],
1770	      h_samples[2],
1771	      h_samples[3],
1772	      h_samples[4],
1773	      h_samples[5],
1774	    )
1775	  } else {
1776	    h_samples[2]	<-- UNCOVERED
1777	  }
1778	
1779	  // 进行垂直插值得到半像素
1780	  let v_samples : Array[Int32] = Array::make(6, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
1781	  for i in 0..<6 {
1782	    v_samples[i] = vp8_get_ref_pixel(ref_plane, px, py - 2 + i, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
1783	  }
1784	  let half_y = if frac_y >= 2 {
1785	    vp8_interpolate_6tap(	<-- UNCOVERED
1786	      v_samples[0],
1787	      v_samples[1],
1788	      v_samples[2],
1789	      v_samples[3],
1790	      v_samples[4],
1791	      v_samples[5],
1792	    )
1793	  } else {
1794	    v_samples[2]	<-- UNCOVERED
1795	  }
1796	
1797	  // 双线性插值（四分之一像素）
1798	  if frac_x == 0 {
1799	    // 只有垂直偏移
1800	    let t = frac_y	<-- UNCOVERED
1801	    return (half_x * (4 - t) + half_y * t + 2) >> 2
1802	  }
1803	  if frac_y == 0 {
1804	    // 只有水平偏移
1805	    let t = frac_x	<-- UNCOVERED
1806	    return (half_y * (4 - t) + half_x * t + 2) >> 2
1807	  }
1808	  // 双向偏移：使用四个角的双线性插值
1809	  let h00 = vp8_get_ref_pixel(ref_plane, px, py, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
1810	  let h10 = half_x
1811	  let h01 = half_y
1812	  // 计算对角半像素（先水平后垂直，或先垂直后水平，取平均）
1813	  let diag_samples_h : Array[Int32] = Array::make(6, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
1814	  for i in 0..<6 {
1815	    diag_samples_h[i] = vp8_get_ref_pixel(	<-- UNCOVERED
1816	      ref_plane,
1817	      px - 2 + i,
1818	      py + 1,
1819	      width,
1820	      height,
1821	    )
1822	  }
1823	  let h11 = vp8_interpolate_6tap(	<-- UNCOVERED
1824	    diag_samples_h[0],
1825	    diag_samples_h[1],
1826	    diag_samples_h[2],
1827	    diag_samples_h[3],
1828	    diag_samples_h[4],
1829	    diag_samples_h[5],
1830	  )
1831	
1832	  let tx = frac_x
1833	  let ty = frac_y
1834	  let a = h00 * (4 - tx) * (4 - ty)
1835	  let b = h10 * tx * (4 - ty)
1836	  let c = h01 * (4 - tx) * ty
1837	  let d = h11 * tx * ty
1838	  (a + b + c + d + 8) >> 4
1839	}
    	…

1844	fn vp8_motion_compensate_16x4_subpixel(
1845	  ref_y : Array[Int32],
1846	  ref_u : Array[Int32],
1847	  ref_v : Array[Int32],
1848	  mb_x : Int32,
1849	  mb_y : Int32,
1850	  mv_x_q4 : Int32,
1851	  mv_y_q4 : Int32,
1852	  width : Int32,
1853	  height : Int32,
1854	) -> (Array[Int32], Array[Int32], Array[Int32]) {
1855	  let pred_y = Array::make(256, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
1856	  let pred_u = Array::make(64, 128)
1857	  let pred_v = Array::make(64, 128)
1858	
1859	  // Y 平面：16x16，1/4 像素精度
1860	  for y in 0..<16 {
1861	    for x in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1862	      pred_y[y * 16 + x] = vp8_interpolate_subpixel(
1863	        ref_y,
1864	        mb_x * 16 + x,
1865	        mb_y * 16 + y,
1866	        mv_x_q4,
1867	        mv_y_q4,
1868	        width,
1869	        height,
1870	      )
1871	    }
1872	  }
1873	
1874	  // U/V 平面：8x8，运动向量减半（1/4 像素 → 1/2 像素）
1875	  let uv_width = width / 2
1876	  let uv_height = height / 2
1877	  let uv_mv_x_q4 = mv_x_q4 / 2
1878	  let uv_mv_y_q4 = mv_y_q4 / 2
1879	  for y in 0..<8 {
1880	    for x in 0..<8 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1881	      pred_u[y * 8 + x] = vp8_interpolate_subpixel(
1882	        ref_u,
1883	        mb_x * 8 + x,
1884	        mb_y * 8 + y,
1885	        uv_mv_x_q4,
1886	        uv_mv_y_q4,
1887	        uv_width,
1888	        uv_height,
1889	      )
1890	      pred_v[y * 8 + x] = vp8_interpolate_subpixel(	<-- UNCOVERED
1891	        ref_v,
1892	        mb_x * 8 + x,
1893	        mb_y * 8 + y,
1894	        uv_mv_x_q4,
1895	        uv_mv_y_q4,
1896	        uv_width,
1897	        uv_height,
1898	      )
1899	    }
1900	  }
1901	
1902	  (pred_y, pred_u, pred_v)
1903	}
    	…

1908	fn vp8_read_ue_golomb(bd : Vp8BoolDecoder) -> Int32 {
1909	  let mut leading_zeros = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1910	  while bd.read_bool(128) == 0 {
1911	    leading_zeros += 1
1912	    if leading_zeros > 31 {
1913	      return 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1914	    }
1915	  }
1916	  if leading_zeros == 0 {
1917	    return 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1918	  }
1919	  let mut value = 1
1920	  for _ in 0..<leading_zeros {
1921	    value = (value << 1) | bd.read_bool(128)	<-- UNCOVERED
1922	  }
1923	  value - 1
1924	}
    	…

1928	fn vp8_read_se_golomb(bd : Vp8BoolDecoder) -> Int32 {
1929	  let value = vp8_read_ue_golomb(bd)	<-- UNCOVERED
1930	  if value == 0 {
1931	    return 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1932	  }
1933	  if value % 2 == 1 {
1934	    (value + 1) / 2	<-- UNCOVERED
1935	  } else {
1936	    -(value / 2)	<-- UNCOVERED
1937	  }
1938	}
    	…

1943	fn vp8_parse_mv_residual(bd : Vp8BoolDecoder, prob : Int32) -> Int32 {
1944	  ignore(prob)	<-- UNCOVERED
1945	  // 简化实现：使用 Exp-Golomb 编码
1946	  // 完整 VP8 使用更复杂的运动向量残差编码
1947	  let residual = vp8_read_se_golomb(bd)	<-- UNCOVERED
1948	  residual * 4 // 转换为 1/4 像素单位
1949	}
    	…

1962	fn vp8_parse_ref_frame(bd : Vp8BoolDecoder, ref_prob : Int32) -> Vp8RefFrame {
1963	  // 简化实现：使用概率选择参考帧
1964	  let is_last = bd.read_bool(ref_prob) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1965	  if is_last {
1966	    return Vp8RefFrame::RefLast	<-- UNCOVERED
1967	  }
1968	  let is_golden = bd.read_bool(128) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1969	  if is_golden {
1970	    Vp8RefFrame::RefGolden	<-- UNCOVERED
1971	  } else {
1972	    Vp8RefFrame::RefAltref	<-- UNCOVERED
1973	  }
1974	}

1992	fn vp8_parse_full_motion_vector(
1993	  bd : Vp8BoolDecoder,
1994	  pred_mv : Vp8MotionVector,
1995	  mv_prob : Int32,
1996	) -> (Int32, Int32) {
1997	  // 解析是否使用预测运动向量
1998	  let use_pred = bd.read_bool(mv_prob) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1999	  if use_pred {
2000	    return (pred_mv.mv_x * 4, pred_mv.mv_y * 4)	<-- UNCOVERED
2001	  }
2002	  // 解析运动向量残差
2003	  let dx = vp8_parse_mv_residual(bd, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
2004	  let dy = vp8_parse_mv_residual(bd, 128)
2005	  (pred_mv.mv_x * 4 + dx, pred_mv.mv_y * 4 + dy)
2006	}

2011	fn _vp8_parse_motion_vector(

2018	  // 完整实现需要解析运动向量残差（使用 Golomb 编码）

2020	  mv.mv_y = pred_mv.mv_y
2021	  mv

2026	fn vp8_predict_motion_vector(
2027	  left_mv : Vp8MotionVector,
2028	  above_mv : Vp8MotionVector,
2029	  above_left_mv : Vp8MotionVector,
2030	) -> Vp8MotionVector {
2031	  let pred = Vp8MotionVector::new()	<-- UNCOVERED
2032	  // 中值预测
2033	  let xs = [left_mv.mv_x, above_mv.mv_x, above_left_mv.mv_x]
2034	  let ys = [left_mv.mv_y, above_mv.mv_y, above_left_mv.mv_y]
2035	  // 简单排序取中值
2036	  let mut x_median = xs[0]
2037	  if (xs[1] - xs[0]) * (xs[2] - xs[0]) <= 0 {
2038	    x_median = xs[0]	<-- UNCOVERED
2039	  } else if (xs[0] - xs[1]) * (xs[2] - xs[1]) <= 0 {
2040	    x_median = xs[1]
2041	  } else {
2042	    x_median = xs[2]	<-- UNCOVERED
2043	  }
2044	  let mut y_median = ys[0]
2045	  if (ys[1] - ys[0]) * (ys[2] - ys[0]) <= 0 {
2046	    y_median = ys[0]	<-- UNCOVERED
2047	  } else if (ys[0] - ys[1]) * (ys[2] - ys[1]) <= 0 {
2048	    y_median = ys[1]
2049	  } else {
2050	    y_median = ys[2]	<-- UNCOVERED
2051	  }
2052	  pred.mv_x = x_median
2053	  pred.mv_y = y_median
2054	  pred
2055	}

2061	pub fn decode_vp8_frame(
2062	  data : Bytes,
2063	  offset : Int32,
2064	) -> @types.Image raise @types.LoadError {
2065	  let br = Vp8BitReader::new(data, offset)
2066	  let header = parse_vp8_frame_header(br)
2067	
2068	  if !header.key_frame {
2069	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("VP8 非关键帧暂不支持")	<-- UNCOVERED
2070	  }
2071	
2072	  if header.width == 0 || header.height == 0 {
2073	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("VP8 帧尺寸无效")
2074	  }
2075	
2076	  let w = header.width
2077	  let h = header.height
2078	
2079	  // 解析量化参数
2080	  let quant = parse_quantization(br)	<-- UNCOVERED
2081	
2082	  // 解析 segment 参数
2083	  let segment = parse_segmentation(br)	<-- UNCOVERED
2084	
2085	  // 简化实现：创建一个纯色图像（灰色）
2086	  // 完整的 VP8 解码需要解析残差系数、进行 IDCT、帧内预测等
2087	  // 这里先实现基础框架，后续迭代完善
2088	  let base_y = 128 - quant.y_dc / 4
2089	  let base_u = 128 - quant.uv_ac / 4
2090	  let base_v = 128 - quant.uv_dc / 4
2091	  let y_plane : Array[Int32] = Array::make(w * h, base_y)	<-- UNCOVERED
2092	  let u_plane : Array[Int32] = Array::make(w / 2 * (h / 2), base_u)
2093	  let v_plane : Array[Int32] = Array::make(w / 2 * (h / 2), base_v)
2094	
2095	  // 帧内预测 + 残差系数解析 + IDCT 反变换
2096	  // 创建布尔解码器用于残差系数解析和预测模式解析
2097	  let bd = Vp8BoolDecoder::new(data, offset + 10)	<-- UNCOVERED
2098	  let coeff_probs = Vp8AdaptiveProbs::new()
2099	  let mb_mode_probs = Vp8MbModeProbs::new()
2100	
2101	  // 对每个 16x16 宏块：解析预测模式 + 残差解析
2102	  let mb_w = (w + 15) / 16
2103	  let mb_h = (h + 15) / 16
2104	  // 保存每个宏块的 segment ID（用于环路滤波）
2105	  let segment_id_map : Array[Int32] = Array::make(mb_w * mb_h, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
2106	  for mb_y in 0..<mb_h {
2107	    for mb_x in 0..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
2108	      // 解析宏块的 segment ID
2109	      let segment_id = if segment.enabled && segment.update_map {	<-- UNCOVERED
2110	        vp8_parse_mb_segment_id(bd, segment.mb_segment_tree_probs)
2111	      } else {
2112	        0	<-- UNCOVERED
2113	      }
2114	      segment_id_map[mb_y * mb_w + mb_x] = segment_id
2115	
2116	      // 根据 segment ID 计算实际量化参数
2117	      let _ = vp8_get_quant_for_segment(quant, segment, segment_id)	<-- UNCOVERED
2118	
2119	      // 生成参考像素
2120	      let above : Array[Int32] = Array::make(16, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
2121	      let left : Array[Int32] = Array::make(16, 128)
2122	      let above_left = 128
2123	
2124	      // 从 bitstream 解析 I16x16 预测模式（使用自适应概率模型）
2125	      let mode = vp8_parse_i16x16_mode(bd, mb_mode_probs)	<-- UNCOVERED
2126	
2127	      // 解析色度预测模式（UV 平面）
2128	      let uv_mode = vp8_parse_uv_mode(bd, mb_mode_probs)	<-- UNCOVERED
2129	      ignore(uv_mode) // 色度预测暂未完全实现，UV 平面使用基础值
2130	
2131	      let pred = vp8_intra_predict_16x16(mode, above, left, above_left)	<-- UNCOVERED
2132	
2133	      // 解析 DC 系数（16x16 块的 DC 系数组成 4x4 块）
2134	      let dc_coeffs = vp8_parse_dc_coeffs_16x16(bd, coeff_probs)	<-- UNCOVERED
2135	      let dc_residual = vp8_wht_4x4(dc_coeffs)
2136	
2137	      // 对每个 4x4 子块解析 AC 系数并进行 IDCT
2138	      for sub_y in 0..<4 {
2139	        for sub_x in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
2140	          // 解析 AC 系数
2141	          let ac_coeffs = vp8_parse_residual_4x4(bd, coeff_probs, false)	<-- UNCOVERED
2142	          // 将 DC 系数添加到 AC 系数中
2143	          ac_coeffs[0] = ac_coeffs[0] + dc_residual[sub_y * 4 + sub_x]
2144	          // IDCT 反变换
2145	          let residual = vp8_idct_4x4(ac_coeffs)	<-- UNCOVERED
2146	          // 将预测和残差相加
2147	          for y in 0..<4 {
2148	            for x in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
2149	              let px = mb_x * 16 + sub_x * 4 + x
2150	              let py = mb_y * 16 + sub_y * 4 + y
2151	              if px < w && py < h {
2152	                let pred_y = sub_y * 4 + y	<-- UNCOVERED
2153	                let pred_x = sub_x * 4 + x
2154	                let mut val = pred[pred_y * 16 + pred_x] + residual[y * 4 + x]
2155	                if val < 0 {
2156	                  val = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
2157	                }
2158	                if val > 255 {
2159	                  val = 255	<-- UNCOVERED
2160	                }
2161	                y_plane[py * w + px] = val
2162	              }
2163	            }
2164	          }
2165	        }
2166	      }
2167	      // 更新宏块预测模式概率（EMA）
2168	      mb_mode_probs.update()	<-- UNCOVERED
2169	    }
2170	  }
2171	
2172	  // 环路滤波（基于 segment 的自适应滤波强度）
2173	  let base_filter_level = quant.y_ac / 4
2174	  for mb_y in 0..<mb_h {
2175	    for mb_x in 0..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
2176	      let segment_id = segment_id_map[mb_y * mb_w + mb_x]
2177	      let mb_filter_level = vp8_get_filter_level_for_segment(
2178	        base_filter_level, segment, segment_id,
2179	      )
2180	      vp8_loop_filter_mb(	<-- UNCOVERED
2181	        y_plane, u_plane, v_plane, mb_x, mb_y, w, h, mb_filter_level,
2182	      )
2183	    }
2184	  }
2185	
2186	  // YUV420 转 RGB
2187	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(w * h * 3, b'\x00')	<-- UNCOVERED
2188	  for y in 0..<h {
2189	    for x in 0..<w {	<-- UNCOVERED
2190	      let y_val = y_plane[y * w + x]
2191	      let u_val = u_plane[y / 2 * (w / 2) + x / 2]
2192	      let v_val = v_plane[y / 2 * (w / 2) + x / 2]
2193	
2194	      // YUV 转 RGB（简化）
2195	      let c = y_val - 16
2196	      let d = u_val - 128
2197	      let e = v_val - 128
2198	
2199	      let mut r = (298 * c + 409 * e + 128) >> 8
2200	      let mut g = (298 * c - 100 * d - 208 * e + 128) >> 8
2201	      let mut b = (298 * c + 516 * d + 128) >> 8
2202	
2203	      if r < 0 {
2204	        r = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
2205	      }
2206	      if r > 255 {
2207	        r = 255	<-- UNCOVERED
2208	      }
2209	      if g < 0 {
2210	        g = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
2211	      }
2212	      if g > 255 {
2213	        g = 255	<-- UNCOVERED
2214	      }
2215	      if b < 0 {
2216	        b = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
2217	      }
2218	      if b > 255 {
2219	        b = 255	<-- UNCOVERED
2220	      }
2221	
2222	      let idx = (y * w + x) * 3
2223	      out[idx] = r.to_byte()	<-- UNCOVERED
2224	      out[idx + 1] = g.to_byte()
2225	      out[idx + 2] = b.to_byte()
2226	    }
2227	  }
2228	
2229	  @types.Image::{
2230	    width: w,
2231	    height: h,
2232	    channels: 3,
2233	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),	<-- UNCOVERED
2234	  }
2235	}
    	…

2241	pub fn decode_vp8_inter_frame(
2242	  data : Bytes,
2243	  offset : Int32,
2244	  refs : Vp8ReferenceFrames,
2245	) -> (@types.Image, Vp8ReferenceFrames) raise @types.LoadError {
2246	  let br = Vp8BitReader::new(data, offset)	<-- UNCOVERED
2247	  let header = parse_vp8_frame_header(br)
2248	
2249	  if header.key_frame {
2250	    // 关键帧：使用常规解码并更新参考帧
2251	    let img = decode_vp8_frame(data, offset)	<-- UNCOVERED
2252	    // 将关键帧复制到参考帧
2253	    let w = img.width
2254	    let h = img.height
2255	    let y_size = w * h
2256	    let uv_size = w / 2 * (h / 2)
2257	    let new_refs = Vp8ReferenceFrames::new(w, h)	<-- UNCOVERED
2258	    // 从 RGB 转换回 YUV（简化：使用亮度作为 Y，UV 固定为 128）
2259	    for i in 0..<y_size {
2260	      let r = img.data[i * 3].to_int()	<-- UNCOVERED
2261	      let g = img.data[i * 3 + 1].to_int()
2262	      let b = img.data[i * 3 + 2].to_int()
2263	      let y = ((66 * r + 129 * g + 25 * b + 128) >> 8) + 16
2264	      new_refs.last_y[i] = y
2265	      new_refs.golden_y[i] = y
2266	      new_refs.altref_y[i] = y
2267	    }
2268	    for i in 0..<uv_size {
2269	      new_refs.last_u[i] = 128	<-- UNCOVERED
2270	      new_refs.last_v[i] = 128
2271	      new_refs.golden_u[i] = 128
2272	      new_refs.golden_v[i] = 128
2273	      new_refs.altref_u[i] = 128
2274	      new_refs.altref_v[i] = 128
2275	    }
2276	    return (img, new_refs)
2277	  }
2278	
2279	  // 非关键帧：使用帧间预测
2280	  let w = header.width
2281	  let h = header.height
2282	
2283	  if w == 0 || h == 0 {
2284	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("VP8 帧尺寸无效")	<-- UNCOVERED
2285	  }
2286	
2287	  // 解析量化参数
2288	  let quant = parse_quantization(br)	<-- UNCOVERED
2289	
2290	  let y_plane : Array[Int32] = Array::make(w * h, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
2291	  let u_plane : Array[Int32] = Array::make(w / 2 * (h / 2), 128)
2292	  let v_plane : Array[Int32] = Array::make(w / 2 * (h / 2), 128)
2293	
2294	  // 创建布尔解码器
2295	  let bd = Vp8BoolDecoder::new(data, offset + 10)	<-- UNCOVERED
2296	  let coeff_probs = Vp8AdaptiveProbs::new()
2297	  let mb_mode_probs = Vp8MbModeProbs::new()
2298	
2299	  // 运动向量预测缓存（用于相邻宏块的运动向量预测）
2300	  let mb_w = (w + 15) / 16
2301	  let mb_h = (h + 15) / 16
2302	  let mv_cache : Array[Vp8MotionVector] = Array::make(	<-- UNCOVERED
2303	    mb_w * mb_h,
2304	    Vp8MotionVector::new(),	<-- UNCOVERED
2305	  )
2306	
2307	  // 对每个宏块进行解码
2308	  for mb_y in 0..<mb_h {
2309	    for mb_x in 0..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
2310	      // 解析宏块类型（帧内/帧间/跳过）
2311	      let is_intra = bd.read_bool(180) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
2312	
2313	      if is_intra {
2314	        // 帧内预测宏块
2315	        let above : Array[Int32] = Array::make(16, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
2316	        let left : Array[Int32] = Array::make(16, 128)
2317	        let above_left = 128
2318	        let mode = vp8_parse_i16x16_mode(bd, mb_mode_probs)	<-- UNCOVERED
2319	        let uv_mode = vp8_parse_uv_mode(bd, mb_mode_probs)
2320	        ignore(uv_mode)
2321	        let pred = vp8_intra_predict_16x16(mode, above, left, above_left)
2322	
2323	        // 解析 DC 系数
2324	        let dc_coeffs = vp8_parse_dc_coeffs_16x16(bd, coeff_probs)	<-- UNCOVERED
2325	        let dc_residual = vp8_wht_4x4(dc_coeffs)
2326	
2327	        // 解析 AC 系数并进行 IDCT
2328	        for sub_y in 0..<4 {
2329	          for sub_x in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
2330	            let ac_coeffs = vp8_parse_residual_4x4(bd, coeff_probs, false)
2331	            ac_coeffs[0] = ac_coeffs[0] + dc_residual[sub_y * 4 + sub_x]
2332	            let residual = vp8_idct_4x4(ac_coeffs)	<-- UNCOVERED
2333	            for y in 0..<4 {
2334	              for x in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
2335	                let px = mb_x * 16 + sub_x * 4 + x
2336	                let py = mb_y * 16 + sub_y * 4 + y
2337	                if px < w && py < h {
2338	                  let pred_y = sub_y * 4 + y	<-- UNCOVERED
2339	                  let pred_x = sub_x * 4 + x
2340	                  let mut val = pred[pred_y * 16 + pred_x] + residual[y * 4 + x]
2341	                  if val < 0 {
2342	                    val = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
2343	                  }
2344	                  if val > 255 {
2345	                    val = 255	<-- UNCOVERED
2346	                  }
2347	                  y_plane[py * w + px] = val
2348	                }
2349	              }
2350	            }
2351	          }
2352	        }
2353	      } else {
2354	        // 帧间预测宏块（运动补偿）
2355	        // 解析参考帧选择
2356	        let ref_frame = vp8_parse_ref_frame(bd, 200)	<-- UNCOVERED
2357	        let (ref_y, ref_u, ref_v) = vp8_get_ref_planes(refs, ref_frame)
2358	
2359	        // 运动向量预测（使用相邻宏块的中值）
2360	        let left_mv = if mb_x > 0 {
2361	          mv_cache[mb_y * mb_w + mb_x - 1]	<-- UNCOVERED
2362	        } else {
2363	          Vp8MotionVector::new()	<-- UNCOVERED
2364	        }
2365	        let above_mv = if mb_y > 0 {
2366	          mv_cache[(mb_y - 1) * mb_w + mb_x]	<-- UNCOVERED
2367	        } else {
2368	          Vp8MotionVector::new()	<-- UNCOVERED

390	fn vp8_select_i16x16_mode(
391	  y_plane : Array[Int32],
392	  mb_x : Int32,
393	  mb_y : Int32,
394	  width : Int32,
395	  height : Int32,
396	) -> Vp8I16x16PredMode {

398	  let modes = [	<-- UNCOVERED
399	    Vp8I16x16PredMode::I16x16DcPred,
400	    Vp8I16x16PredMode::I16x16TrueMotionPred,

409	        vp8_predict_i16x16_dc(y_plane, mb_x, mb_y, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
410	      Vp8I16x16PredMode::I16x16TrueMotionPred =>
411	        vp8_predict_i16x16_tm(y_plane, mb_x, mb_y, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
412	      Vp8I16x16PredMode::I16x16HPred =>
413	        vp8_predict_i16x16_h(y_plane, mb_x, mb_y, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
414	      Vp8I16x16PredMode::I16x16VPred =>
415	        vp8_predict_i16x16_v(y_plane, mb_x, mb_y, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
416	    }
417	    // 计算 SAD
418	    let mut sad = 0
419	    for y in 0..<16 {
420	      for x in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
421	        let px = mb_x * 16 + x
422	        let py = mb_y * 16 + y
423	        if px < width && py < height {

425	          let p = pred[y * 16 + x]

427	        }
428	      }
429	    }
430	    if sad < best_sad {
431	      best_sad = sad	<-- UNCOVERED
432	      best_mode = mode
433	    }
434	  }
435	  best_mode
436	}

455	    Vp8I16x16PredMode::I16x16VPred =>
456	      vp8_predict_i16x16_v(y_plane, mb_x, mb_y, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
457	  }
458	}
   	…

464	fn vp8_encode_block_tokens(
465	  enc : Vp8BoolEncoder,
466	  coeffs : Array[Int32],
467	  is_dc : Bool,
468	) -> Unit {
469	  ignore(is_dc)	<-- UNCOVERED
470	  // zig-zag 顺序
471	  let zigzag = [0, 1, 4, 8, 5, 2, 3, 6, 9, 12, 13, 10, 7, 11, 14, 15]
472	  let mut eob = false
473	  for i in 0..<16 {
474	    if eob {	<-- UNCOVERED
475	      break
476	    }
477	    let pos = zigzag[i]
478	    let c = coeffs[pos]
479	    if c == 0 {
480	      // 零系数
481	      if i > 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
482	        // 检查是否是 EOB
483	        let mut has_nonzero = false	<-- UNCOVERED
484	        for j in (i + 1)..<16 {
485	          if coeffs[zigzag[j]] != 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
486	            has_nonzero = true
487	            break
488	          }
489	        }
490	        if !has_nonzero {
491	          enc.encode_bool(1, 100) // EOB	<-- UNCOVERED
492	          eob = true
493	        } else {
494	          enc.encode_bool(0, 100) // 不是 EOB	<-- UNCOVERED
495	        }
496	      }
497	      enc.encode_bool(1, 200) // 零系数	<-- UNCOVERED
498	    } else {
499	      // 非零系数
500	      if i > 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
501	        enc.encode_bool(0, 100) // 不是 EOB
502	      }
503	      enc.encode_bool(0, 200) // 非零系数	<-- UNCOVERED
504	      // 编码值（简化：直接编码绝对值和符号）
505	      let abs_val = c.abs()	<-- UNCOVERED
506	      if abs_val == 1 {
507	        enc.encode_bool(1, 170) // 值为 1	<-- UNCOVERED
508	      } else {
509	        enc.encode_bool(0, 170) // 值大于 1	<-- UNCOVERED
510	        // 编码额外位（简化）
511	        let mut extra = abs_val - 1
512	        while extra > 0 {
513	          enc.encode_bit(1) // 继续	<-- UNCOVERED
514	          extra = extra >> 1
515	        }
516	        enc.encode_bit(0) // 结束	<-- UNCOVERED
517	      }
518	      // 符号位
519	      if c < 0 {
520	        enc.encode_bit(1)	<-- UNCOVERED
521	      } else {
522	        enc.encode_bit(0)	<-- UNCOVERED
523	      }
524	    }
525	  }
526	  if !eob {	<-- UNCOVERED
527	    // 没有 EOB，所有系数都非零
528	  }
529	}

547	fn vp8_enc_segment_params_new(
548	  y_plane : Array[Int32],
549	  width : Int32,
550	  height : Int32,
551	  base_quant : Int32,
552	) -> Vp8EncSegmentParams {
553	  ignore(base_quant)	<-- UNCOVERED
554	  let mb_w = (width + 15) / 16
555	  let mb_h = (height + 15) / 16
556	  let total_mbs = mb_w * mb_h
557	  let segment_id_map : Array[Int32] = Array::make(total_mbs, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
558	  // 计算每个宏块的复杂度（方差）
559	  let complexities : Array[Int32] = Array::make(total_mbs, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
560	  for mb_y in 0..<mb_h {
561	    for mb_x in 0..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
562	      let mut sum = 0
563	      let mut sum_sq = 0
564	      let mut count = 0
565	      for y in 0..<16 {
566	        for x in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
567	          let px = mb_x * 16 + x
568	          let py = mb_y * 16 + y
569	          if px < width && py < height {
570	            let val = y_plane[py * width + px]	<-- UNCOVERED
571	            sum += val
572	            sum_sq += val * val
573	            count += 1
574	          }
575	        }
576	      }
577	      if count > 0 {
578	        let mean = sum / count	<-- UNCOVERED
579	        let variance = sum_sq / count - mean * mean
580	        complexities[mb_y * mb_w + mb_x] = variance
581	      }
582	    }
583	  }
584	  // 根据复杂度分配 segment（0=低复杂度, 3=高复杂度）
585	  let mut max_complexity = 1
586	  for c in complexities {
587	    if c > max_complexity {	<-- UNCOVERED
588	      max_complexity = c
589	    }
590	  }
591	  for i in 0..<total_mbs {
592	    let ratio = complexities[i] * 4 / max_complexity	<-- UNCOVERED
593	    segment_id_map[i] = ratio.clamp(min=0, max=3)
594	  }
595	  // 量化器增量（高复杂度 segment 使用更小的量化增量，即更高质量）
596	  let quantizer_delta = [0, -4, -8, -12]
597	  // 滤波级别增量（高复杂度 segment 使用更强的滤波）
598	  let filter_level_delta = [0, 2, 4, 6]
599	  Vp8EncSegmentParams::{
600	    segmentation_enabled: true,
601	    quantizer_delta,
602	    _filter_level_delta: filter_level_delta,
603	    segment_id_map,
604	  }
605	}
   	…

609	fn vp8_enc_get_mb_quant(
610	  segment : Vp8EncSegmentParams,
611	  mb_x : Int32,
612	  mb_y : Int32,
613	  mb_w : Int32,
614	  base_quant : Int32,
615	) -> Int32 {
616	  if !segment.segmentation_enabled {	<-- UNCOVERED
617	    return base_quant
618	  }
619	  let idx = mb_y * mb_w + mb_x
620	  if idx >= 0 && idx < segment.segment_id_map.length() {	<-- UNCOVERED
621	    let seg_id = segment.segment_id_map[idx]
622	    let delta = segment.quantizer_delta[seg_id]
623	    return (base_quant + delta).clamp(min=1, max=127)	<-- UNCOVERED
624	  }
625	  base_quant
626	}
   	…

632	fn vp8_encoder_loop_filter(
633	  y_plane : Array[Int32],
634	  width : Int32,
635	  height : Int32,
636	  filter_level : Int32,
637	) -> Unit {
638	  if filter_level == 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
639	    return
640	  }
641	  let mb_w = (width + 15) / 16
642	  let mb_h = (height + 15) / 16
643	  // 宏块边界垂直滤波
644	  for mb_y in 0..<mb_h {
645	    for mb_x in 1..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
646	      for y in 0..<16 {
647	        let py = mb_y * 16 + y
648	        if py >= height {
649	          break	<-- UNCOVERED
650	        }
651	        let px = mb_x * 16
652	        if px > 0 && px < width {
653	          let idx = py * width + px	<-- UNCOVERED
654	          let p1 = y_plane[idx - 1]
655	          let p0 = y_plane[idx]
656	          let diff = p0 - p1
657	          if diff.abs() < filter_level {	<-- UNCOVERED
658	            let adj = diff / 2
659	            y_plane[idx - 1] = p1 + adj
660	            y_plane[idx] = p0 - adj
661	          }
662	        }
663	      }
664	    }
665	  }
666	  // 宏块边界水平滤波
667	  for mb_y in 1..<mb_h {
668	    for mb_x in 0..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
669	      for x in 0..<16 {
670	        let px = mb_x * 16 + x
671	        if px >= width {
672	          break	<-- UNCOVERED
673	        }
674	        let py = mb_y * 16
675	        if py > 0 && py < height {
676	          let idx = py * width + px	<-- UNCOVERED
677	          let p1 = y_plane[idx - width]
678	          let p0 = y_plane[idx]
679	          let diff = p0 - p1
680	          if diff.abs() < filter_level {	<-- UNCOVERED
681	            let adj = diff / 2
682	            y_plane[idx - width] = p1 + adj
683	            y_plane[idx] = p0 - adj
684	          }
685	        }
686	      }
687	    }
688	  }
689	}

710	fn vp8_enc_adaptive_probs_new() -> Vp8EncAdaptiveProbs {
711	  // 初始概率：均匀分布
712	  let token_probs : Array[Int32] = Array::make(64, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
713	  let pred_mode_probs : Array[Int32] = [128, 128, 128, 128]
714	  let token_counts : Array[Int32] = Array::make(64, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
715	  let pred_mode_counts : Array[Int32] = [0, 0, 0, 0]
716	  Vp8EncAdaptiveProbs::{
717	    token_probs,
718	    pred_mode_probs,
719	    token_counts,
720	    pred_mode_counts,
721	    update_interval: 8,
722	    blocks_since_update: 0,
723	  }
724	}
   	…

728	fn vp8_enc_adaptive_probs_update(probs : Vp8EncAdaptiveProbs) -> Unit {
729	  // 更新 token 概率
730	  for i in 0..<64 {	<-- UNCOVERED
731	    let count = probs.token_counts[i]
732	    if count > 0 {
733	      // EMA 更新：new_prob = old_prob * 0.875 + observed * 0.125
734	      let observed = (255 * count / (count + 1)).clamp(min=1, max=254)	<-- UNCOVERED
735	      probs.token_probs[i] = (probs.token_probs[i] * 7 + observed) / 8
736	      probs.token_counts[i] = 0
737	    }
738	  }
739	  // 更新预测模式概率
740	  let total = probs.pred_mode_counts[0] +
741	    probs.pred_mode_counts[1] +
742	    probs.pred_mode_counts[2] +
743	    probs.pred_mode_counts[3]
744	  if total > 0 {
745	    for i in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
746	      let observed = (255 * probs.pred_mode_counts[i] / total).clamp(
747	        min=1,
748	        max=254,
749	      )
750	      probs.pred_mode_probs[i] = (probs.pred_mode_probs[i] * 7 + observed) / 8
751	      probs.pred_mode_counts[i] = 0
752	    }
753	  }
754	  probs.blocks_since_update = 0
755	}
   	…

759	fn _vp8_enc_adaptive_probs_record_token(
760	  probs : Vp8EncAdaptiveProbs,
761	  pos : Int32,
762	  token_type : Int32,
763	) -> Unit {
764	  if pos >= 0 && pos < 16 && token_type >= 0 && token_type < 4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
765	    probs.token_counts[pos * 4 + token_type] += 1
766	  }
767	}

774	) -> Unit {
775	  if mode >= 0 && mode < 4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
776	    probs.pred_mode_counts[mode] += 1
777	  }

784	fn vp8_build_frame_header(
785	  width : Int32,
786	  height : Int32,
787	  first_part_size : Int32,
788	) -> Bytes {
789	  let result : Array[Byte] = []	<-- UNCOVERED
790	  // 3 bytes: frame tag
791	  let tag = (0 << 0) | (0 << 1) | (1 << 4) | (first_part_size << 5)
792	  result.push((tag & 0xFF).to_byte())	<-- UNCOVERED
793	  result.push(((tag >> 8) & 0xFF).to_byte())
794	  result.push(((tag >> 16) & 0xFF).to_byte())
795	  // 3 bytes: start code
796	  result.push(b'\x9D')	<-- UNCOVERED
797	  result.push(b'\x01')
798	  result.push(b'\x2A')
799	  // 2 bytes: width + horizontal scale
800	  result.push((width & 0xFF).to_byte())	<-- UNCOVERED
801	  result.push(((width >> 8) & 0x3F).to_byte())
802	  // 2 bytes: height + vertical scale
803	  result.push((height & 0xFF).to_byte())	<-- UNCOVERED
804	  result.push(((height >> 8) & 0x3F).to_byte())
805	  Bytes::from_array(result)
806	}

810	fn vp8_build_webp_container(
811	  width : Int32,
812	  height : Int32,
813	  vp8_data : Bytes,
814	) -> Bytes {
815	  let result : Array[Byte] = []	<-- UNCOVERED
816	  // RIFF header
817	  result.push(b'\x52') // R	<-- UNCOVERED
818	  result.push(b'\x49') // I
819	  result.push(b'\x46') // F
820	  result.push(b'\x46') // F
821	  // file size (placeholder)
822	  let file_size_pos = result.length()	<-- UNCOVERED
823	  result.push(b'\x00')
824	  result.push(b'\x00')
825	  result.push(b'\x00')
826	  result.push(b'\x00')
827	  // WEBP
828	  result.push(b'\x57') // W	<-- UNCOVERED
829	  result.push(b'\x45') // E
830	  result.push(b'\x42') // B
831	  result.push(b'\x50') // P
832	  // VP8 chunk
833	  result.push(b'\x56') // V	<-- UNCOVERED
834	  result.push(b'\x50') // P
835	  result.push(b'\x38') // 8
836	  result.push(b'\x20') // space
837	  // chunk size (placeholder)
838	  let chunk_size_pos = result.length()	<-- UNCOVERED
839	  result.push(b'\x00')
840	  result.push(b'\x00')
841	  result.push(b'\x00')
842	  result.push(b'\x00')
843	  // VP8 data
844	  let vp8_len = vp8_data.length()	<-- UNCOVERED
845	  for i in 0..<vp8_len {
846	    result.push(vp8_data[i])	<-- UNCOVERED
847	  }
848	  // 填充到偶数长度
849	  if vp8_len % 2 != 0 {
850	    result.push(b'\x00')	<-- UNCOVERED
851	  }
852	  // 回填 chunk size
853	  let chunk_size = vp8_len
854	  result[chunk_size_pos] = (chunk_size & 0xFF).to_byte()	<-- UNCOVERED
855	  result[chunk_size_pos + 1] = ((chunk_size >> 8) & 0xFF).to_byte()
856	  result[chunk_size_pos + 2] = ((chunk_size >> 16) & 0xFF).to_byte()
857	  result[chunk_size_pos + 3] = ((chunk_size >> 24) & 0xFF).to_byte()
858	  // 回填 file size
859	  let total_size = result.length() - 8	<-- UNCOVERED
860	  result[file_size_pos] = (total_size & 0xFF).to_byte()
861	  result[file_size_pos + 1] = ((total_size >> 8) & 0xFF).to_byte()
862	  result[file_size_pos + 2] = ((total_size >> 16) & 0xFF).to_byte()
863	  result[file_size_pos + 3] = ((total_size >> 24) & 0xFF).to_byte()
864	  let _ = width
865	  let _ = height
866	  Bytes::from_array(result)	<-- UNCOVERED
867	}
