661	fn match_multilingual_enhanced(
662	  char_img : @types.Image,
663	  templates : Array[(String, Array[Double])],
664	  distance_metric : String,
665	) -> (String, Double) {
666	  let w = char_img.width
667	  let h = char_img.height
668	  let data = char_img.data
669	  // 提取网格特征
670	  let grid_size = 16
671	  let cell_w = w / grid_size
672	  let cell_h = h / grid_size
673	  let features : Array[Double] = []
674	  for r in 0..<grid_size {
675	    for c in 0..<grid_size {
676	      let mut count = 0
677	      let mut total = 0
678	      for py in 0..<cell_h {
679	        for px in 0..<cell_w {
680	          let sx = c * cell_w + px
681	          let sy = r * cell_h + py
682	          if sx < w && sy < h {
683	            total += 1
684	            if data[sy * w + sx].to_int() > 128 {
685	              count += 1
686	            }
687	          }
688	        }
689	      }
690	      let density = if total > 0 {
691	        count.to_double() / total.to_double()
692	      } else {
693	        0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
694	      }
695	      features.push(density)
696	    }
697	  }
698	  // 模板匹配
699	  let mut best_label = "?"
700	  let mut best_dist = 1000000.0
701	  for _tup2 in templates {
702	    let (label, template) = _tup2
703	    let n = if features.length() < template.length() {
704	      features.length()
705	    } else {
706	      template.length()
707	    }
708	    let mut dist = 0.0
709	    match distance_metric {
710	      "manhattan" =>
711	        for i in 0..<n {	<-- UNCOVERED
712	          dist += (features[i] - template[i]).abs()
713	        }
714	      "cosine" => {	<-- UNCOVERED
715	        let mut dot = 0.0
716	        let mut norm_a = 0.0
717	        let mut norm_b = 0.0
718	        for i in 0..<n {
719	          dot += features[i] * template[i]	<-- UNCOVERED
720	          norm_a += features[i] * features[i]
721	          norm_b += template[i] * template[i]
722	        }
723	        let denom = norm_a.sqrt() * norm_b.sqrt()	<-- UNCOVERED
724	        dist = if denom > 0.0 { 1.0 - dot / denom } else { 1.0 }
725	      }

733	    }
734	    if dist < best_dist {

736	      best_label = label

738	  }
739	  let confidence = if best_dist > 0.0 { 1.0 / (1.0 + best_dist) } else { 1.0 }

151	        let mut sum = 0.0

156	            let py = y0 + dy

162	              weight_sum += weight
163	            }
164	          }
165	        }
166	        let value = if weight_sum > 0.0 { sum / weight_sum } else { 0.0 }

169	        } else if value > 255.0 {
170	          255.0	<-- UNCOVERED
171	        } else {
172	          value
173	        }
174	        out_data[(y * out_w + x) * channels + c] = clamped.to_int().to_byte()
175	      }
176	    }
177	  }
178	  @types.Image::{
179	    width: out_w,
180	    height: out_h,
181	    channels,

188	pub fn super_resolution_edge_preserving(
189	  img : @types.Image,
190	  scale : Double,
191	  edge_threshold~ : Double = 30.0,
192	  sharpen_amount~ : Double = 0.5,
193	) -> @types.Image {
194	  let et = edge_threshold
195	  let sa = sharpen_amount
196	  // 第一步：双三次插值
197	  let upscaled = super_resolution_bicubic(img, scale)
198	  // 第二步：边缘检测（Sobel）
199	  let edges = detect_edges_sobel(upscaled)
200	  // 第三步：在边缘区域进行锐化
201	  let w = upscaled.width
202	  let h = upscaled.height
203	  let channels = upscaled.channels
204	  let data = upscaled.data
205	  let out_data : Array[Byte] = Array::make(w * h * channels, b'\x00')
206	  for y in 0..<h {
207	    for x in 0..<w {
208	      for c in 0..<channels {
209	        let idx = (y * w + x) * channels + c
210	        let edge_strength = edges[y * w + x]
211	        if edge_strength > et && x > 0 && x < w - 1 && y > 0 && y < h - 1 {
212	          // 锐化：中心像素加权，减去邻域模糊
213	          let center = data[idx].to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
214	          let mut neighbor_sum = 0.0
215	          let neighbors = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
216	          for _tup0 in neighbors {
217	            let (dx, dy) = _tup0	<-- UNCOVERED
218	            neighbor_sum += data[((y + dy) * w + (x + dx)) * channels + c].to_double()
219	          }
220	          let sharpened = center * (1.0 + sa) - neighbor_sum * sa / 4.0
221	          let clamped = if sharpened < 0.0 {
222	            0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
223	          } else if sharpened > 255.0 {
224	            255.0
225	          } else {
226	            sharpened	<-- UNCOVERED
227	          }
228	          out_data[idx] = clamped.to_int().to_byte()	<-- UNCOVERED
229	        } else {
230	          out_data[idx] = data[idx]
231	        }
232	      }
233	    }
234	  }
235	  @types.Image::{
236	    width: w,
237	    height: h,
238	    channels,
239	    data: Bytes::from_array(out_data),
240	  }
241	}

245	fn detect_edges_sobel(img : @types.Image) -> Array[Double] {
246	  let w = img.width
247	  let h = img.height
248	  let data = img.data
249	  let channels = img.channels
250	  let edges : Array[Double] = Array::make(w * h, 0.0)
251	  // 转换为灰度
252	  let gray : Array[Double] = []
253	  for i in 0..<(w * h) {
254	    if channels >= 3 {
255	      let r = data[i * channels].to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
256	      let g = data[i * channels + 1].to_double()
257	      let b = data[i * channels + 2].to_double()
258	      gray.push(0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b)
259	    } else {
260	      gray.push(data[i * channels].to_double())
261	    }
262	  }
263	  // Sobel 算子
264	  let gx_kernel = [
265	    (-1, -1, -1),
266	    (0, -1, 0),
267	    (1, -1, 1),
268	    (-1, 0, -2),
269	    (0, 0, 0),
270	    (1, 0, 2),
271	    (-1, 1, -1),
272	    (0, 1, 0),
273	    (1, 1, 1),
274	  ]
275	  let gy_kernel = [
276	    (-1, -1, -1),
277	    (0, -1, -2),
278	    (1, -1, -1),
279	    (-1, 0, 0),
280	    (0, 0, 0),
281	    (1, 0, 0),
282	    (-1, 1, 1),
283	    (0, 1, 2),
284	    (1, 1, 1),
285	  ]
286	  for y in 1..<(h - 1) {
287	    for x in 1..<(w - 1) {
288	      let mut gx = 0.0
289	      let mut gy = 0.0
290	      for i in 0..<9 {
291	        let (dx, dy, weight) = gx_kernel[i]
292	        gx += gray[(y + dy) * w + (x + dx)] * weight.to_double()
293	      }
294	      for i in 0..<9 {
295	        let (dx, dy, weight) = gy_kernel[i]
296	        gy += gray[(y + dy) * w + (x + dx)] * weight.to_double()
297	      }
298	      edges[y * w + x] = (gx * gx + gy * gy).sqrt()
299	    }
300	  }
301	  edges
302	}

201	pub fn otsu_threshold_value(
202	  img : @types.Image,
203	) -> Double raise @types.LoadError {
204	  // 输入验证
205	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {

221	  let w = img.width
222	  let h = img.height
223	  let histogram : Array[Int32] = []
224	  for _ in 0..<256 {
225	    histogram.push(0)	<-- UNCOVERED
226	  }
227	
228	  for y in 0..<h {
229	    for x in 0..<w {	<-- UNCOVERED
230	      let pixel = img.data[y * w + x].to_int()
231	      histogram[pixel] += 1
232	    }

236	  let mut sum = 0.0
237	  for i in 0..<256 {
238	    sum += i.to_double() * histogram[i].to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
239	  }

242	  let mut w_b = 0

248	    if w_b == 0 {

258	    let variance = w_b.to_double() * w_f.to_double() * (m_b - m_f) * (m_b - m_f)
259	    if variance > max_variance {
260	      max_variance = variance	<-- UNCOVERED
261	      threshold = i.to_double()
262	    }
263	  }
264	
265	  threshold
266	}

270	pub fn kmeans_segmentation(
271	  img : @types.Image,
272	  config : KMeansConfig,
273	) -> SemanticSegmentationResult raise @types.LoadError {
274	  // 输入验证
275	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
276	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
277	      "kmeans_segmentation: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
278	    )
279	  }
280	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
281	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
282	      "kmeans_segmentation: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
283	    )
284	  }
285	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
286	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {	<-- UNCOVERED
287	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
288	      "kmeans_segmentation: 数据大小不匹配",
289	    )
290	  }
291	  let w = img.width
292	  let h = img.height
293	  let k = config.num_clusters
294	  let total = w * h
295	
296	  // 初始化聚类中心
297	  let centers : Array[Double] = []
298	  for i in 0..<k {
299	    centers.push(i.to_double() * 255.0 / k.to_double() + 128.0 / k.to_double())	<-- UNCOVERED
300	  }
301	
302	  let labels : Array[Int32] = []
303	  for _ in 0..<total {
304	    labels.push(0)	<-- UNCOVERED
305	  }
306	
307	  // K-Means 迭代
308	  for _ in 0..<config.max_iterations {
309	    // 分配标签
310	    for i in 0..<total {	<-- UNCOVERED
311	      let pixel = img.data[i].to_double()
312	      let mut min_dist = 1000000.0
313	      let mut best_cluster = 0
314	      for c in 0..<k {
315	        let dist = (pixel - centers[c]) * (pixel - centers[c])	<-- UNCOVERED
316	        if dist < min_dist {
317	          min_dist = dist	<-- UNCOVERED
318	          best_cluster = c
319	        }
320	      }
321	      labels[i] = best_cluster
322	    }
323	
324	    // 更新聚类中心
325	    let sums : Array[Double] = []
326	    let counts : Array[Int32] = []
327	    for _ in 0..<k {
328	      sums.push(0.0)	<-- UNCOVERED
329	      counts.push(0)
330	    }
331	    for i in 0..<total {
332	      let pixel = img.data[i].to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
333	      let cluster = labels[i]
334	      sums[cluster] += pixel
335	      counts[cluster] += 1
336	    }
337	    for c in 0..<k {
338	      if counts[c] > 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
339	        centers[c] = sums[c] / counts[c].to_double()
340	      }
341	    }
342	  }
343	
344	  // 统计每个类别的像素数
345	  let pixel_counts : Array[Int32] = []
346	  for _ in 0..<k {
347	    pixel_counts.push(0)	<-- UNCOVERED
348	  }
349	  for i in 0..<total {
350	    pixel_counts[labels[i]] += 1	<-- UNCOVERED
351	  }
352	
353	  let label_info : Array[SegmentationLabel] = []
354	  let colors = [
355	    (255, 0, 0),
356	    (0, 255, 0),
357	    (0, 0, 255),
358	    (255, 255, 0),
359	    (255, 0, 255),
360	    (0, 255, 255),
361	    (128, 0, 0),
362	    (0, 128, 0),
363	    (0, 0, 128),
364	    (128, 128, 128),
365	  ]
366	  for c in 0..<k {
367	    label_info.push(SegmentationLabel::{	<-- UNCOVERED
368	      id: c,
369	      name: "class_" + c.to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
370	      color: colors[c % colors.length()],
371	      pixel_count: pixel_counts[c],
372	    })
373	  }
374	
375	  SemanticSegmentationResult::{
376	    width: w,
377	    height: h,
378	    labels,
379	    label_info,
380	    num_classes: k,
381	    inference_time_ms: 0.0,
382	  }
383	}

387	pub fn superpixel_segmentation(
388	  img : @types.Image,
389	  num_superpixels : Int32,
390	) -> SuperpixelResultAdv raise @types.LoadError {
391	  // 输入验证
392	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
393	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
394	      "superpixel_segmentation: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
395	    )
396	  }
397	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
398	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
399	      "superpixel_segmentation: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
400	    )
401	  }
402	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
403	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {	<-- UNCOVERED
404	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
405	      "superpixel_segmentation: 数据大小不匹配",
406	    )
407	  }
408	  let w = img.width
409	  let h = img.height
410	  let total = w * h
411	  let step = (total.to_double() / num_superpixels.to_double()).sqrt().to_int()	<-- UNCOVERED
412	  let _ = w / step * (h / step)
413	
414	  let labels : Array[Int32] = []
415	  for _ in 0..<total {
416	    labels.push(-1)	<-- UNCOVERED
417	  }
418	
419	  // 初始化超像素中心
420	  let centers_x : Array[Double] = []
421	  let centers_y : Array[Double] = []
422	  let centers_color : Array[Double] = []
423	  let mut sp_id = 0
424	  let mut cy = step / 2
425	  while cy < h {
426	    let mut cx = step / 2	<-- UNCOVERED
427	    while cx < w {
428	      centers_x.push(cx.to_double())	<-- UNCOVERED
429	      centers_y.push(cy.to_double())
430	      centers_color.push(img.data[cy * w + cx].to_double())
431	      sp_id += 1
432	      cx += step
433	    }
434	    cy += step
435	  }
436	
437	  // 简化的 SLIC 迭代
438	  for _ in 0..<5 {
439	    for sp in 0..<sp_id {	<-- UNCOVERED
440	      let cx = centers_x[sp].to_int()
441	      let cy = centers_y[sp].to_int()
442	      for y in (cy - step)..<(cy + step) {
443	        if y < 0 || y >= h {	<-- UNCOVERED
444	          continue
445	        }
446	        for x in (cx - step)..<(cx + step) {
447	          if x < 0 || x >= w {	<-- UNCOVERED
448	            continue
449	          }
450	          let idx = y * w + x
451	          let pixel = img.data[idx].to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
452	          let color_dist = (pixel - centers_color[sp]).abs()
453	          let spatial_dist = (
454	              (x.to_double() - centers_x[sp]).abs() +	<-- UNCOVERED
455	              (y.to_double() - centers_y[sp]).abs()
456	            ) /
457	            step.to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
458	          let dist = color_dist + spatial_dist * 10.0
459	          if labels[idx] == -1 || dist < 50.0 {
460	            labels[idx] = sp	<-- UNCOVERED
461	          }
462	        }
463	      }
464	    }
465	  }
466	
467	  // 计算超像素信息
468	  let superpixels : Array[Superpixel] = []
469	  for sp in 0..<sp_id {
470	    let mut sum_x = 0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
471	    let mut sum_y = 0.0
472	    let mut sum_color = 0.0
473	    let mut count = 0
474	    for y in 0..<h {
475	      for x in 0..<w {	<-- UNCOVERED
476	        if labels[y * w + x] == sp {
477	          sum_x += x.to_double()
478	          sum_y += y.to_double()
479	          sum_color += img.data[y * w + x].to_double()
480	          count += 1
481	        }
482	      }
483	    }
484	    if count > 0 {
485	      superpixels.push(Superpixel::{	<-- UNCOVERED
486	        id: sp,
487	        center_x: sum_x / count.to_double(),	<-- UNCOVERED
488	        center_y: sum_y / count.to_double(),
489	        size: count,
490	        mean_color: sum_color / count.to_double(),	<-- UNCOVERED
491	        label: sp,
492	      })
493	    }
494	  }
495	
496	  SuperpixelResultAdv::{
497	    width: w,
498	    height: h,
499	    labels,
500	    superpixels,
501	    num_superpixels: superpixels.length(),	<-- UNCOVERED
502	  }
503	}

507	pub fn watershed_segmentation(
508	  img : @types.Image,
509	  config : WatershedConfigAdv,
510	) -> SemanticSegmentationResult raise @types.LoadError {
511	  // 输入验证
512	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
513	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
514	      "watershed_segmentation: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
515	    )
516	  }
517	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
518	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
519	      "watershed_segmentation: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
520	    )
521	  }
522	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
523	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {	<-- UNCOVERED
524	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
525	      "watershed_segmentation: 数据大小不匹配",
526	    )
527	  }
528	  let w = img.width
529	  let h = img.height
530	  let total = w * h
531	
532	  // 简化版：基于梯度的区域生长
533	  let labels : Array[Int32] = []
534	  for _ in 0..<total {
535	    labels.push(-1)	<-- UNCOVERED
536	  }
537	
538	  // 找局部最小值作为种子点
539	  let mut region_id = 0
540	  for y in 1..<(h - 1) {
541	    for x in 1..<(w - 1) {	<-- UNCOVERED
542	      let idx = y * w + x
543	      let pixel = img.data[idx].to_double()
544	      let mut is_min = true
545	      for dy in -1..<2 {
546	        for dx in -1..<2 {	<-- UNCOVERED
547	          if dx == 0 && dy == 0 {
548	            continue
549	          }
550	          let neighbor = img.data[(y + dy) * w + (x + dx)].to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
551	          if neighbor < pixel {
552	            is_min = false	<-- UNCOVERED
553	          }
554	        }
555	      }
556	      if is_min && labels[idx] == -1 {
557	        // 区域生长
558	        let queue_x : Array[Int32] = [x]	<-- UNCOVERED
559	        let queue_y : Array[Int32] = [y]
560	        labels[idx] = region_id
561	        let mut queue_idx = 0
562	        while queue_idx < queue_x.length() {	<-- UNCOVERED
563	          let cx = queue_x[queue_idx]
564	          let cy = queue_y[queue_idx]
565	          queue_idx += 1
566	          for dy in -1..<2 {
567	            for dx in -1..<2 {	<-- UNCOVERED
568	              if dx == 0 && dy == 0 {
569	                continue
570	              }
571	              let nx = cx + dx
572	              let ny = cy + dy
573	              if nx < 0 || nx >= w || ny < 0 || ny >= h {
574	                continue	<-- UNCOVERED
575	              }
576	              let nidx = ny * w + nx
577	              if labels[nidx] == -1 {
578	                let npixel = img.data[nidx].to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
579	                if npixel < pixel + 30.0 {
580	                  labels[nidx] = region_id	<-- UNCOVERED
581	                  queue_x.push(nx)
582	                  queue_y.push(ny)
583	                }
584	              }
585	            }
586	          }
587	        }
588	        region_id += 1
589	        if region_id >= config.max_regions {
590	          break	<-- UNCOVERED
591	        }
592	      }
593	    }
594	    if region_id >= config.max_regions {
595	      break	<-- UNCOVERED
596	    }
597	  }
598	
599	  // 未标记的像素归为背景
600	  for i in 0..<total {
601	    if labels[i] == -1 {	<-- UNCOVERED
602	      labels[i] = region_id // 背景
603	    }
604	  }
605	
606	  // 统计
607	  let pixel_counts : Array[Int32] = []
608	  for _ in 0..<(region_id + 1) {
609	    pixel_counts.push(0)	<-- UNCOVERED
610	  }
611	  for i in 0..<total {
612	    pixel_counts[labels[i]] += 1	<-- UNCOVERED
613	  }
614	
615	  let label_info : Array[SegmentationLabel] = []
616	  for r in 0..<(region_id + 1) {
617	    let name = if r == region_id {	<-- UNCOVERED
618	      "background"
619	    } else {
620	      "region_" + r.to_string()	<-- UNCOVERED
621	    }
622	    label_info.push(SegmentationLabel::{	<-- UNCOVERED
623	      id: r,
624	      name,
625	      color: (r * 37 % 256, r * 73 % 256, r * 113 % 256),
626	      pixel_count: pixel_counts[r],
627	    })
628	  }
629	
630	  SemanticSegmentationResult::{
631	    width: w,
632	    height: h,
633	    labels,
634	    label_info,
635	    num_classes: region_id + 1,
636	    inference_time_ms: 0.0,
637	  }
638	}
   	…

642	pub fn grabcut_segmentation(
643	  img : @types.Image,
644	  rect_x : Int32,
645	  rect_y : Int32,
646	  rect_w : Int32,
647	  rect_h : Int32,
648	  config : GrabCutConfig,
649	) -> SemanticSegmentationResult raise @types.LoadError {
650	  // 输入验证
651	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
652	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
653	      "grabcut_segmentation: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
654	    )
655	  }
656	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
657	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
658	      "grabcut_segmentation: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
659	    )
660	  }
661	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
662	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {	<-- UNCOVERED
663	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
664	      "grabcut_segmentation: 数据大小不匹配",
665	    )
666	  }
667	  let w = img.width
668	  let h = img.height
669	  let total = w * h
670	  let labels : Array[Int32] = []
671	
672	  // 初始化：矩形内为可能前景，外为背景
673	  for y in 0..<h {
674	    for x in 0..<w {	<-- UNCOVERED
675	      if x >= rect_x &&
676	        x < rect_x + rect_w &&
677	        y >= rect_y &&
678	        y < rect_y + rect_h {
679	        labels.push(1) // 可能前景	<-- UNCOVERED
680	      } else {
681	        labels.push(0) // 背景	<-- UNCOVERED
682	      }
683	    }
684	  }
685	
686	  // 简化迭代：基于颜色相似度的前景/背景分类
687	  for _ in 0..<config.num_iterations {
688	    // 计算前景和背景的平均颜色
689	    let mut fg_sum = 0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
690	    let mut fg_count = 0
691	    let mut bg_sum = 0.0
692	    let mut bg_count = 0
693	    for i in 0..<total {
694	      let pixel = img.data[i].to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
695	      if labels[i] == 1 {
696	        fg_sum += pixel	<-- UNCOVERED
697	        fg_count += 1
698	      } else {
699	        bg_sum += pixel	<-- UNCOVERED
700	        bg_count += 1
701	      }
702	    }
703	    let fg_mean = if fg_count > 0 {
704	      fg_sum / fg_count.to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
705	    } else {
706	      128.0	<-- UNCOVERED
707	    }
708	    let bg_mean = if bg_count > 0 {
709	      bg_sum / bg_count.to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
710	    } else {
711	      128.0	<-- UNCOVERED
712	    }
713	
714	    // 重新分类
715	    for i in 0..<total {
716	      let pixel = img.data[i].to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
717	      let fg_dist = (pixel - fg_mean).abs()
718	      let bg_dist = (pixel - bg_mean).abs()
719	      if fg_dist < bg_dist {
720	        labels[i] = 1	<-- UNCOVERED
721	      } else {
722	        labels[i] = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
723	      }
724	    }
725	  }
726	
727	  // 统计
728	  let mut fg_count = 0
729	  let mut bg_count = 0
730	  for i in 0..<total {
731	    if labels[i] == 1 {	<-- UNCOVERED
732	      fg_count += 1
733	    } else {
734	      bg_count += 1	<-- UNCOVERED
735	    }
736	  }
737	
738	  let label_info : Array[SegmentationLabel] = [
739	    SegmentationLabel::{
740	      id: 0,
741	      name: "background",
742	      color: (0, 0, 0),
743	      pixel_count: bg_count,
744	    },
745	    SegmentationLabel::{
746	      id: 1,
747	      name: "foreground",
748	      color: (255, 255, 255),
749	      pixel_count: fg_count,
750	    },
751	  ]
752	
753	  SemanticSegmentationResult::{
754	    width: w,
755	    height: h,
756	    labels,
757	    label_info,
758	    num_classes: 2,
759	    inference_time_ms: 0.0,
760	  }
761	}
   	…

765	pub fn calculate_segmentation_metrics(
766	  prediction : Array[Int32],
767	  ground_truth : Array[Int32],
768	  num_classes : Int32,
769	) -> SegmentationMetrics {
770	  ignore(num_classes)	<-- UNCOVERED
771	  let total = prediction.length()
772	  let mut tp = 0
773	  let mut fp = 0
774	  let mut false_neg = 0
775	  let mut correct = 0
776	
777	  for i in 0..<total {
778	    if prediction[i] == ground_truth[i] {	<-- UNCOVERED
779	      correct += 1
780	    }
781	    if prediction[i] == 1 && ground_truth[i] == 1 {
782	      tp += 1	<-- UNCOVERED
783	    } else if prediction[i] == 1 && ground_truth[i] == 0 {
784	      fp += 1
785	    } else if prediction[i] == 0 && ground_truth[i] == 1 {
786	      false_neg += 1
787	    }
788	  }
789	
790	  let pixel_accuracy = if total > 0 {
791	    correct.to_double() / total.to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
792	  } else {
793	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
794	  }
795	  let iou = if tp + fp + false_neg > 0 {
796	    tp.to_double() / (tp + fp + false_neg).to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
797	  } else {
798	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
799	  }
800	  let dice = if 2 * tp + fp + false_neg > 0 {
801	    (2 * tp).to_double() / (2 * tp + fp + false_neg).to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED
802	  } else {
803	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
804	  }
805	
806	  SegmentationMetrics::{
807	    pixel_accuracy,
808	    mean_iou: iou,
809	    mean_accuracy: pixel_accuracy,
810	    frequency_weighted_iou: iou,
811	    dice_coefficient: dice,
812	    true_positives: tp,
813	    false_positives: fp,
814	    false_negatives: false_neg,
815	  }
816	}
   	…

820	pub fn segmentation_to_image(
821	  result : SemanticSegmentationResult,
822	) -> @types.Image {
823	  let w = result.width	<-- UNCOVERED
824	  let h = result.height
825	  let out : Array[Byte] = []
826	  for i in 0..<(w * h) {
827	    let label = result.labels[i]	<-- UNCOVERED
828	    let mut color = 0
829	    for info in result.label_info {
830	      if info.id == label {	<-- UNCOVERED
831	        color = (info.color.0 + info.color.1 + info.color.2) / 3
832	      }
833	    }
834	    out.push(if color > 127 { b'\xFF' } else { b'\x00' })	<-- UNCOVERED
835	  }
836	  @types.Image::{
837	    width: w,
838	    height: h,
839	    channels: 1,
840	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),	<-- UNCOVERED
841	  }
842	}

846	pub fn segmentation_report_to_string(
847	  result : SemanticSegmentationResult,
848	  metrics : SegmentationMetrics,
849	) -> String {
850	  let mut report = "## 图像分割报告\n\n"	<-- UNCOVERED
851	  report = report + "### 分割结果\n\n"
852	  report = report + "| 指标 | 值 |\n|------|------|\n"
853	  report = report +
854	    "| 图像尺寸 | " +
855	    result.width.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
856	    "x" +
857	    result.height.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
858	    " |\n"
859	  report = report + "| 类别数 | " + result.num_classes.to_string() + " |\n"	<-- UNCOVERED
860	  report = report +
861	    "| 推理耗时 | " +
862	    result.inference_time_ms.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
863	    "ms |\n\n"
864	
865	  report = report + "### 类别统计\n\n"
866	  report = report + "| ID | 名称 | 颜色(RGB) | 像素数 | 占比 |\n"
867	  report = report + "|----|------|-----------|--------|------|\n"
868	  let total = result.width * result.height
869	  for info in result.label_info {
870	    let ratio = if total > 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
871	      info.pixel_count.to_double() / total.to_double() * 100.0
872	    } else {
873	      0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
874	    }
875	    report = report +
876	      "| " +
877	      info.id.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
878	      " | " +
879	      info.name +
880	      " | " +

636	  if img2.data.length() != expected_size2 {

649	
650	  for i in 0..<total {

652	    let p2 = img2.data[i].to_double()
653	    sum1 += p1

215	  transform : AffineTransform,
216	  out_width~ : Int32 = 0,
217	  out_height~ : Int32 = 0,
218	) -> @types.Image raise @types.LoadError {

226	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(

231	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
232	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(

234	    )
235	  }
236	  let ow = if out_width == 0 { img.width } else { out_width }
237	  let oh = if out_height == 0 { img.height } else { out_height }
238	  let w = img.width
239	  let h = img.height
240	  let channels = img.channels
241	  let out_data : Array[Byte] = Array::make(ow * oh * channels, b'\x00')
242	  // 计算逆变换
243	  let det = transform.a * transform.e - transform.b * transform.d
244	  if det.abs() < 0.000001 {
245	    return img	<-- UNCOVERED
246	  }
247	  let inv_a = transform.e / det

250	  let inv_d = -transform.d / det

252	  let inv_f = (transform.d * transform.c - transform.a * transform.f) / det

255	      // 反向映射
256	      let src_x = inv_a * x.to_double() + inv_b * y.to_double() + inv_c
257	      let src_y = inv_d * x.to_double() + inv_e * y.to_double() + inv_f
258	      // 双线性插值
259	      let x0 = src_x.floor().to_int()
260	      let y0 = src_y.floor().to_int()
261	      let x1 = x0 + 1
262	      let y1 = y0 + 1
263	      let fx = src_x - x0.to_double()
264	      let fy = src_y - y0.to_double()

266	      for c in 0..<channels {

270	          let v10 = img.data[(y1 * w + x0) * channels + c].to_double()
271	          let v11 = img.data[(y1 * w + x1) * channels + c].to_double()
272	          let top = v00 * (1.0 - fx) + v01 * fx
273	          let bottom = v10 * (1.0 - fx) + v11 * fx
274	          let value = top * (1.0 - fy) + bottom * fy
275	          out_data[out_idx + c] = value.min(255.0).max(0.0).to_int().to_byte()
276	        } else {
277	          out_data[out_idx + c] = b'\x00'
278	        }
279	      }
280	    }
281	  }
282	  @types.Image::{

285	    channels,
286	    data: Bytes::from_array(out_data),
287	  }

380	pub fn calculate_compression_quality(

401	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
402	      "analyze_texture: 数据大小不匹配",
403	    )
404	  }
405	  let w = img.width
406	  let h = img.height
407	  let total = w * h

410	  let mut texture_complexity = 0.0
411	  for y in 1..<(h - 1) {
412	    for x in 1..<(w - 1) {
413	      let idx = y * w + x
414	      let center = img.data[idx].to_double()
415	      let mut sum = 0.0
416	      for dy in -1..<2 {

420	          }
421	          sum += img.data[(y + dy) * w + (x + dx)].to_double()
422	        }
423	      }
424	      let avg = sum / 8.0
425	      texture_complexity += (center - avg) * (center - avg)
426	    }
427	  }
428	  texture_complexity /= total.to_double()
429	  texture_complexity = texture_complexity.sqrt()

436	      let p2 = img.data[y * w + x + 2].to_double()
437	      texture_regularity += (p1 - p2).abs()
438	    }
439	  }
440	  texture_regularity /= total.to_double()
441	
442	  // AI 生成图像通常纹理复杂度较低且规律性较高
443	  let ai_texture_indicator = if texture_complexity < 15.0 &&
444	    texture_regularity < 10.0 {
445	    0.7
446	  } else if texture_complexity < 25.0 {
447	    0.5
448	  } else {
449	    0.3
450	  }

453	    texture_regularity,
454	    texture_complexity,

458	  }

480	  }

482	  let h = img.height
483	  let _ = w * h
484

486	  let mut edge_sharpness = 0.0
487	  let mut edge_count = 0

492	      let gy = img.data[idx + w].to_double() - img.data[idx - w].to_double()

545	  let ai_edge_indicator = if edge_sharpness < 50.0 && edge_continuity < 0.5 {

182	fn simple_blur(
183	  input : Array[Byte],

185	  h : Int32,
186	  radius : Int32,
187	) -> Array[Byte] {
188	  let output : Array[Byte] = []	<-- UNCOVERED

195	          let nx = x + dx

199	            count += 1

205	          (sum / count).to_byte()	<-- UNCOVERED
206	        } else {
207	          input[y * w + x]	<-- UNCOVERED
208	        },
209	      )

211	  }

257	pub fn cartoon(
258	  img : @types.Image,
259	  levels~ : Int32 = 8,
260	  edge_threshold~ : Double = 30.0,
261	) -> @types.Image {

263	  let et = edge_threshold

266	  let channels = img.channels
267	  let data = img.data

269	  let quantized : Array[Byte] = Array::make(w * h * channels, b'\x00')	<-- UNCOVERED
270	  for i in 0..<(w * h) {
271	    for c in 0..<channels {	<-- UNCOVERED
272	      let idx = i * channels + c
273	      let val = data[idx].to_int()

275	      quantized[idx] = q.min(255).to_byte()	<-- UNCOVERED
276	    }

279	  let edges : Array[Double] = Array::make(w * h, 0.0)	<-- UNCOVERED
280	  for y in 1..<(h - 1) {

283	      // 灰度

285	        let i = (py * w + px) * channels
286	        let r = data[i].to_double()	<-- UNCOVERED

288	        let b = if channels >= 3 { data[i + 2].to_double() } else { r }

292	        2.0 * gray(x - 1, y) -

299	        gray(x + 1, y - 1) +
300	        gray(x - 1, y + 1) +
301	        2.0 * gray(x, y + 1) +
302	        gray(x + 1, y + 1)

308	  for i in 0..<(w * h) {

329	pub fn white_balance(img : @types.Image) -> @types.Image {
330	  let w = img.width
331	  let h = img.height
332	  let channels = img.channels
333	  if channels < 3 {
334	    return img	<-- UNCOVERED
335	  }
336	  // 计算各通道平均值
337	  let mut sum_r = 0.0
338	  let mut sum_g = 0.0
339	  let mut sum_b = 0.0
340	  let total = (w * h).to_double()
341	  for y in 0..<h {
342	    for x in 0..<w {
343	      let idx = (y * w + x) * channels
344	      sum_r += img.data[idx].to_double()
345	      sum_g += img.data[idx + 1].to_double()
346	      sum_b += img.data[idx + 2].to_double()
347	    }
348	  }
349	  let avg_r = sum_r / total
350	  let avg_g = sum_g / total
351	  let avg_b = sum_b / total
352	  let avg_gray = (avg_r + avg_g + avg_b) / 3.0
353	  // 计算增益
354	  let gain_r = avg_gray / avg_r.max(1.0)
355	  let gain_g = avg_gray / avg_g.max(1.0)
356	  let gain_b = avg_gray / avg_b.max(1.0)
357	  // 应用增益
358	  let out_data : Array[Byte] = Array::make(w * h * channels, b'\x00')
359	  for y in 0..<h {
360	    for x in 0..<w {
361	      let idx = (y * w + x) * channels
362	      out_data[idx] = (img.data[idx].to_double() * gain_r)
363	        .min(255.0)
364	        .max(0.0)
365	        .to_int()
366	        .to_byte()
367	      out_data[idx + 1] = (img.data[idx + 1].to_double() * gain_g)
368	        .min(255.0)
369	        .max(0.0)
370	        .to_int()
371	        .to_byte()
372	      out_data[idx + 2] = (img.data[idx + 2].to_double() * gain_b)
373	        .min(255.0)
374	        .max(0.0)
375	        .to_int()
376	        .to_byte()
377	      for c in 3..<channels {
378	        out_data[idx + c] = img.data[idx + c]	<-- UNCOVERED
379	      }
380	    }
381	  }
382	  @types.Image::{
383	    width: w,
384	    height: h,
385	    channels,
386	    data: Bytes::from_array(out_data),
387	  }
388	}

168	  }
169	
170	  // 检测垂直长线
171	  let mut vertical_lines = 0
172	  for x in 0..<w {
173	    let mut run_length = 0
174	    for y in 0..<h {
175	      let idx = y * w + x
176	      let is_edge = if y > 0 && y < h - 1 {
177	        let diff = (img.data[idx].to_double() - img.data[idx - w].to_double()).abs()
178	        diff > 20.0
179	      } else {
180	        false
181	      }
182	      if is_edge {
183	        run_length += 1
184	      } else {
185	        if run_length > h / 4 {
186	          vertical_lines += 1
187	        }
188	        run_length = 0
189	      }
190	    }
191	    if run_length > h / 4 {
192	      vertical_lines += 1	<-- UNCOVERED
193	    }
194	  }
195	
196	  // 检测窗口边框（图像四周的边框）
197	  let has_window_border = horizontal_lines >= 2 && vertical_lines >= 2
198	
199	  // 检测工具栏（顶部的密集水平线条区域）
200	  let has_toolbar = horizontal_lines >= 3
201	
202	  // UI 区域比例（有边缘的区域比例）
203	  let mut ui_area = 0
204	  for y in 0..<h {
205	    for x in 0..<w {
206	      let idx = y * w + x
207	      let mut has_edge = false
208	      if x > 0 && x < w - 1 {
209	        if (img.data[idx].to_double() - img.data[idx - 1].to_double()).abs() >
210	          20.0 {
211	          has_edge = true
212	        }
213	      }
214	      if y > 0 && y < h - 1 {
215	        if (img.data[idx].to_double() - img.data[idx - w].to_double()).abs() >
216	          20.0 {
217	          has_edge = true
218	        }
219	      }
220	      if has_edge {
221	        ui_area += 1
222	      }
223	    }
224	  }
225	  let ui_area_ratio = ui_area.to_double() / total.to_double()
226	
227	  // 按钮状元素检测（小矩形区域）
228	  let button_like = horizontal_lines >= 4 && vertical_lines >= 4
229	
230	  // UI 指示值：UI 元素越多，越可能是屏幕截图（物理生成）
231	  let ui_indicator = if has_window_border && has_toolbar {
232	    0.9
233	  } else if horizontal_lines >= 3 || vertical_lines >= 3 {
234	    0.7	<-- UNCOVERED
235	  } else if horizontal_lines >= 2 || vertical_lines >= 2 {
236	    0.5	<-- UNCOVERED
237	  } else {
238	    0.2
239	  }
240	
241	  UIDetectionResult::{
242	    has_window_border,
243	    has_toolbar,
244	    has_button_like_elements: button_like,
245	    ui_element_count: horizontal_lines + vertical_lines,
246	    ui_area_ratio,
247	    horizontal_line_count: horizontal_lines,
248	    vertical_line_count: vertical_lines,
249	    ui_indicator,
250	  }
251	}

255	pub fn detect_text_regions(
256	  img : @types.Image,
257	) -> TextDetectionResult raise @types.LoadError {
258	  // 输入验证
259	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
260	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
261	      "detect_text_regions: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
262	    )
263	  }
264	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
265	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
266	      "detect_text_regions: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
267	    )
268	  }
269	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
270	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
271	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
272	      "detect_text_regions: 数据大小不匹配",
273	    )
274	  }
275	  let w = img.width
276	  let h = img.height
277	  let total = w * h
278	
279	  // 检测密集小边缘区域（文字特征）
280	  let mut dense_edge_regions = 0
281	  let block_size = 16
282	  let blocks_x = w / block_size
283	  let blocks_y = h / block_size
284	
285	  for by in 0..<blocks_y {
286	    for bx in 0..<blocks_x {
287	      let mut edge_count = 0
288	      for y in 0..<block_size {
289	        for x in 0..<block_size {
290	          let px = bx * block_size + x
291	          let py = by * block_size + y
292	          if px > 0 && px < w - 1 && py > 0 && py < h - 1 {
293	            let idx = py * w + px
294	            let gx = (img.data[idx + 1].to_double() -
295	            img.data[idx - 1].to_double()).abs()
296	            let gy = (img.data[idx + w].to_double() -
297	            img.data[idx - w].to_double()).abs()
298	            if gx > 15.0 || gy > 15.0 {
299	              edge_count += 1
300	            }
301	          }
302	        }
303	      }
304	      let edge_density = edge_count.to_double() /
305	        (block_size * block_size).to_double()
306	      // 文字区域通常边缘密度在 0.15-0.5 之间
307	      if edge_density > 0.15 && edge_density < 0.6 {
308	        dense_edge_regions += 1
309	      }
310	    }
311	  }
312	
313	  let text_area_ratio = dense_edge_regions.to_double() /
314	    (blocks_x * blocks_y).to_double()
315	
316	  // 小边缘密度（全局）
317	  let mut small_edges = 0
318	  for y in 1..<(h - 1) {
319	    for x in 1..<(w - 1) {
320	      let idx = y * w + x
321	      let gx = (img.data[idx + 1].to_double() - img.data[idx - 1].to_double()).abs()
322	      let gy = (img.data[idx + w].to_double() - img.data[idx - w].to_double()).abs()
323	      let mag = (gx * gx + gy * gy).sqrt()
324	      if mag > 10.0 && mag < 80.0 {
325	        small_edges += 1
326	      }
327	    }
328	  }
329	  let small_edge_density = small_edges.to_double() / total.to_double()
330	
331	  // 文字指示值：文字区域越多，越可能是屏幕截图（物理生成）
332	  let text_indicator = if text_area_ratio > 0.15 {
333	    0.85
334	  } else if text_area_ratio > 0.08 {
335	    0.65	<-- UNCOVERED
336	  } else if text_area_ratio > 0.03 {
337	    0.45	<-- UNCOVERED
338	  } else {
339	    0.2
340	  }
341	
342	  TextDetectionResult::{
343	    text_area_count: dense_edge_regions,
344	    text_area_ratio,
345	    dense_edge_region_count: dense_edge_regions,
346	    small_edge_density,
347	    text_like_region_ratio: text_area_ratio,
348	    text_indicator,
349	  }
350	}

354	pub fn analyze_geometry(
355	  img : @types.Image,
356	) -> GeometryAnalysisResult raise @types.LoadError {
357	  // 输入验证
358	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
359	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
360	      "analyze_geometry: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
361	    )
362	  }
363	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
364	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
365	      "analyze_geometry: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
366	    )
367	  }
368	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
369	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
370	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
371	      "analyze_geometry: 数据大小不匹配",
372	    )
373	  }
374	  let w = img.width
375	  let h = img.height
376	
377	  // 边缘方向分析
378	  let mut horizontal_edges = 0
379	  let mut vertical_edges = 0
380	  let mut diagonal_edges = 0
381	  let mut total_edges = 0
382	
383	  for y in 1..<(h - 1) {
384	    for x in 1..<(w - 1) {
385	      let idx = y * w + x
386	      let gx = img.data[idx + 1].to_double() - img.data[idx - 1].to_double()
387	      let gy = img.data[idx + w].to_double() - img.data[idx - w].to_double()
388	      let mag = (gx * gx + gy * gy).sqrt()
389	      if mag > 20.0 {
390	        total_edges += 1
391	        let abs_gx = gx.abs()
392	        let abs_gy = gy.abs()
393	        if abs_gx > abs_gy * 2.0 {
394	          horizontal_edges += 1
395	        } else if abs_gy > abs_gx * 2.0 {
396	          vertical_edges += 1
397	        } else {
398	          diagonal_edges += 1
399	        }
400	      }
401	    }
402	  }
403	
404	  let horizontal_ratio = if total_edges > 0 {
405	    horizontal_edges.to_double() / total_edges.to_double()
406	  } else {
407	    0.0
408	  }
409	  let vertical_ratio = if total_edges > 0 {
410	    vertical_edges.to_double() / total_edges.to_double()
411	  } else {
412	    0.0
413	  }
414	  let diagonal_ratio = if total_edges > 0 {
415	    diagonal_edges.to_double() / total_edges.to_double()
416	  } else {
417	    0.0
418	  }
419	
420	  // 几何规则性：水平+垂直边缘比例越高，越规则（UI 界面特征）
421	  let geometry_regularity = horizontal_ratio + vertical_ratio
422	
423	  // 矩形状区域检测（规则的水平垂直线条交叉）
424	  let rectangle_regions = if geometry_regularity > 0.7 {
425	    total_edges / 100
426	  } else {
427	    0
428	  }
429	
430	  // 几何指示值：几何越规则，越可能是屏幕截图（物理生成）
431	  let geometry_indicator = if geometry_regularity > 0.8 {
432	    0.85
433	  } else if geometry_regularity > 0.65 {
434	    0.65
435	  } else if geometry_regularity > 0.5 {
436	    0.45
437	  } else {
438	    0.25
439	  }
440	
441	  GeometryAnalysisResult::{
442	    horizontal_edge_ratio: horizontal_ratio,
443	    vertical_edge_ratio: vertical_ratio,
444	    diagonal_edge_ratio: diagonal_ratio,
445	    rectangle_like_region_count: rectangle_regions,
446	    straight_line_count: horizontal_edges + vertical_edges,
447	    geometry_regularity,
448	    geometry_indicator,
449	  }
450	}
   	…

454	pub fn analyze_color_quantization(
455	  img : @types.Image,
456	) -> ColorQuantizationResult raise @types.LoadError {
457	  // 输入验证
458	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
459	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
460	      "analyze_color_quantization: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
461	    )
462	  }
463	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
464	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
465	      "analyze_color_quantization: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
466	    )
467	  }
468	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
469	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
470	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
471	      "analyze_color_quantization: 数据大小不匹配",
472	    )
473	  }
474	  let w = img.width
475	  let h = img.height
476	  let total = w * h
477	
478	  // 统计唯一颜色数量（量化到 64 级）
479	  let color_histogram : Array[Int32] = []
480	  for _ in 0..<64 {
481	    color_histogram.push(0)
482	  }
483	  for i in 0..<total {
484	    let bin = img.data[i].to_int() * 64 / 256
485	    color_histogram[bin] += 1
486	  }
487	
488	  let mut unique_colors = 0
489	  for i in 0..<64 {
490	    if color_histogram[i] > 0 {
491	      unique_colors += 1
492	    }
493	  }
494	
495	  // 顶部颜色比例
496	  let sorted_colors : Array[Int32] = []
497	  for i in 0..<64 {
498	    sorted_colors.push(color_histogram[i])
499	  }
500	  // 冒泡排序
501	  for i in 0..<64 {
502	    for j in 0..<(64 - i - 1) {
503	      if sorted_colors[j] < sorted_colors[j + 1] {
504	        let temp = sorted_colors[j]
505	        sorted_colors[j] = sorted_colors[j + 1]
506	        sorted_colors[j + 1] = temp
507	      }
508	    }
509	  }
510	
511	  let top_color_ratio = if total > 0 {
512	    sorted_colors[0].to_double() / total.to_double()
513	  } else {
514	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
515	  }
516	  let mut top_10_sum = 0
517	  for i in 0..<10 {
518	    top_10_sum += sorted_colors[i]
519	  }
520	  let top_10_ratio = if total > 0 {
521	    top_10_sum.to_double() / total.to_double()
522	  } else {
523	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
524	  }
525	
526	  // 颜色量化级别：唯一颜色越少，量化越严重（UI 界面特征）
527	  let quantization_level = 1.0 - unique_colors.to_double() / 64.0
528	
529	  // 颜色调色板大小（估计）
530	  let palette_size = unique_colors
531	
532	  // 颜色量化指示值：颜色越集中，越可能是屏幕截图（物理生成）
533	  let color_quantization_indicator = if top_10_ratio > 0.8 {
534	    0.85
535	  } else if top_10_ratio > 0.65 {
536	    0.65	<-- UNCOVERED
537	  } else if top_10_ratio > 0.5 {
538	    0.45	<-- UNCOVERED
539	  } else {
540	    0.25
541	  }
542	
543	  ColorQuantizationResult::{
544	    unique_color_count: unique_colors,
545	    color_quantization_level: quantization_level,
546	    top_color_ratio,
547	    top_10_color_ratio: top_10_ratio,
548	    color_palette_size: palette_size,
549	    color_quantization_indicator,
550	  }
551	}
   	…

555	pub fn analyze_solid_areas(img : @types.Image) -> Double raise @types.LoadError {
556	  // 输入验证
557	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
558	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
559	      "analyze_solid_areas: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
560	    )
561	  }
562	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
563	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
564	      "analyze_solid_areas: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
565	    )
566	  }
567	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
568	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
569	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
570	      "analyze_solid_areas: 数据大小不匹配",
571	    )
572	  }
573	  let w = img.width
574	  let h = img.height
575	  let _ = w * h
576	  let block_size = 8
577	  let mut solid_blocks = 0
578	  let total_blocks = w / block_size * (h / block_size)
579	
580	  for by in 0..<(h / block_size) {
581	    for bx in 0..<(w / block_size) {
582	      let mut min_val = 255
583	      let mut max_val = 0
584	      for y in 0..<block_size {
585	        for x in 0..<block_size {
586	          let px = bx * block_size + x
587	          let py = by * block_size + y
588	          let val = img.data[py * w + px].to_int()
589	          if val < min_val {
590	            min_val = val
591	          }
592	          if val > max_val {
593	            max_val = val
594	          }
595	        }
596	      }
597	      if max_val - min_val < 10 {
598	        solid_blocks += 1
599	      }
600	    }
601	  }
602	
603	  let solid_ratio = if total_blocks > 0 {
604	    solid_blocks.to_double() / total_blocks.to_double()
605	  } else {
606	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
607	  }
608	
609	  // 纯色区域指示值：纯色区域越多，越可能是屏幕截图（物理生成）
610	  if solid_ratio > 0.5 {
611	    0.8
612	  } else if solid_ratio > 0.35 {
613	    0.6	<-- UNCOVERED
614	  } else if solid_ratio > 0.2 {
615	    0.4	<-- UNCOVERED
616	  } else {
617	    0.2
618	  }
619	}

659	pub fn analyze_pixel_distribution(
660	  img : @types.Image,
661	) -> Double raise @types.LoadError {
662	  // 输入验证
663	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
664	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
665	      "analyze_pixel_distribution: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
666	    )
667	  }
668	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
669	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
670	      "analyze_pixel_distribution: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
671	    )
672	  }
673	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
674	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
675	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
676	      "analyze_pixel_distribution: 数据大小不匹配",
677	    )
678	  }
679	  let w = img.width
680	  let h = img.height
681	  let total = w * h
682	
683	  // 计算像素值分布的熵
684	  let histogram : Array[Int32] = []
685	  for _ in 0..<256 {
686	    histogram.push(0)
687	  }
688	  for i in 0..<total {
689	    histogram[img.data[i].to_int()] += 1
690	  }
691	
692	  let mut entropy = 0.0
693	  for i in 0..<256 {
694	    if histogram[i] > 0 {
695	      let p = histogram[i].to_double() / total.to_double()
696	      entropy -= p * p * 0.1 // 简化的 log2
697	    }
698	  }
699	
700	  // 像素分布越集中（熵越低），越可能是 UI 界面（物理生成）
701	  if entropy < 0.5 {
702	    0.75
703	  } else if entropy < 1.0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
704	    0.55
705	  } else if entropy < 1.5 {
706	    0.35
707	  } else {
708	    0.2	<-- UNCOVERED
709	  }
710	}

714	pub fn intelligent_decision(
715	  basic_result : SourceVerificationResult,
716	  ui_result : UIDetectionResult,
717	  text_result : TextDetectionResult,
718	  geometry_result : GeometryAnalysisResult,
719	  color_result : ColorQuantizationResult,
720	  solid_indicator : Double,
721	  edge_dir_indicator : Double,
722	  pixel_dist_indicator : Double,
723	  config : EnhancedVerificationConfig,
724	) -> (ImageSourceType, Double, Double, Double, String) {
725	  // 增强特征的物理生成指示值（值越高越可能是物理生成）
726	  let enhanced_physical_score = ui_result.ui_indicator * 0.25 +
727	    text_result.text_indicator * 0.20 +
728	    geometry_result.geometry_indicator * 0.15 +
729	    color_result.color_quantization_indicator * 0.15 +
730	    solid_indicator * 0.10 +
731	    edge_dir_indicator * 0.08 +
732	    pixel_dist_indicator * 0.07
733	
734	  // 基础特征的 AI 生成指示值
735	  let basic_ai_score = basic_result.ai_probability
736	
737	  // 加权融合
738	  let final_ai_score = basic_ai_score * config.basic_weight +
739	    (1.0 - enhanced_physical_score) * config.enhanced_weight
740	  let final_physical_score = 1.0 - final_ai_score
741	
742	  // 智能决策规则
743	  let mut decision_reason = ""
744	  let mut source_type = ImageSourceType::Unknown
745	  let mut confidence = 0.0
746	
747	  // 强 UI 特征判定
748	  if ui_result.has_window_border &&
749	    ui_result.has_toolbar &&
750	    text_result.text_area_ratio > 0.05 {
751	    source_type = ImageSourceType::PhysicalCaptured
752	    confidence = 0.9
753	    decision_reason = "检测到窗口边框、工具栏和文字区域，强烈判定为屏幕截图（物理生成）"
754	  } else if ui_result.ui_element_count >= 6 &&
755	    geometry_result.geometry_regularity > 0.7 {
756	    source_type = ImageSourceType::PhysicalCaptured	<-- UNCOVERED
757	    confidence = 0.8
758	    decision_reason = "检测到大量 UI 元素和规则几何形状，判定为屏幕截图（物理生成）"
759	  } else if text_result.text_area_ratio > 0.1 &&
760	    color_result.top_10_color_ratio > 0.7 {
761	    source_type = ImageSourceType::PhysicalCaptured
762	    confidence = 0.75
763	    decision_reason = "检测到大量文字区域和集中的颜色分布，判定为屏幕截图（物理生成）"
764	  } else if enhanced_physical_score > 0.65 {
765	    source_type = ImageSourceType::PhysicalCaptured	<-- UNCOVERED

542	pub fn xray_enhance(xray_image : @types.Image, energy_kev : Double) -> XRayData {

551	  for i in 0..<total {
552	    let v = xray_image.data[i].to_double()
553	    sum += v
554	    sum_sq += v * v
555	  }

558	  let std_dev = if variance > 0.0 { variance.sqrt() } else { 1.0 }

564	    let enhanced = normalized * 40.0 + 128.0
565	    let clamped = if enhanced < 0.0 {
566	      0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
567	    } else if enhanced > 255.0 {
568	      255.0	<-- UNCOVERED
569	    } else {
570	      enhanced
571	    }
572	    out.push(clamped.to_int().to_byte())
573	  }

575	  XRayData::{

579	      channels: 1,

581	    },
582	    energy_kev,

591	pub fn ultrasound_synthesize(
592	  width : Int32,

610	      let dy = y.to_double() / height.to_double()
611	      let distance = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt()
612	
613	      let attenuation = 1.0 - dy * 0.5

619	      } else if b_value > 255.0 {
620	        255.0	<-- UNCOVERED
621	      } else {
622	        b_value
623	      }
624	      b_out.push(b_clamped.to_int().to_byte())
625	
626	      // 简化的多普勒：血流信号
627	      let doppler_value = if distance < 0.2 && dy > 0.3 {
628	        noise * 255.0	<-- UNCOVERED
629	      } else {
630	        0.0
631	      }
632	      doppler_out.push(doppler_value.to_int().to_byte())

370	pub fn dehaze_dark_channel(
371	  img : @types.Image,
372	  omega : Double,
373	  t0 : Double,
374	) -> DehazeResult {
375	  let w = img.width
376	  let h = img.height
377	  let total = w * h

389	      for dy in 0..<patch_size {
390	        for dx in 0..<patch_size {

392	          let ny = y + dy - patch_size / 2
393	          if nx >= 0 && nx < w && ny >= 0 && ny < h {
394	            let val = img.data[ny * w + nx].to_double()
395	            if val < min_val {

397	            }
398	          }
399	        }

417	      atmospheric_light += img.data[i].to_double()
418	      count += 1
419	    }
420	  }
421	  if count > 0 {
422	    atmospheric_light /= count.to_double()

425	  // 计算透射率
426	  let transmission : Array[Double] = []
427	  for i in 0..<total {

441	    } else if dehazed > 255.0 {
442	      255.0	<-- UNCOVERED

543	pub fn derain_morphological(img : @types.Image) -> DerainResult {
544	  let w = img.width
545	  let h = img.height
546	  let _ = w * h
547	
548	  // 简化：中值滤波去除雨线
549	  let out : Array[Byte] = []
550	  for y in 0..<h {
551	    for x in 0..<w {
552	      // 3x3 中值滤波
553	      let neighbors : Array[Int32] = []
554	      for dy in -1..<2 {
555	        for dx in -1..<2 {
556	          let nx = x + dx
557	          let ny = y + dy
558	          if nx >= 0 && nx < w && ny >= 0 && ny < h {
559	            neighbors.push(img.data[ny * w + nx].to_int())
560	          }
561	        }
562	      }
563	      // 排序取中值
564	      for i in 0..<neighbors.length() {
565	        for j in 0..<(neighbors.length() - i - 1) {
566	          if neighbors[j] > neighbors[j + 1] {
567	            let temp = neighbors[j]	<-- UNCOVERED
568	            neighbors[j] = neighbors[j + 1]
569	            neighbors[j + 1] = temp
570	          }
571	        }
572	      }
573	      let median = neighbors[neighbors.length() / 2]
574	      out.push(median.to_byte())
575	    }
576	  }
577	
578	  DerainResult::{
579	    image: @types.Image::{
580	      width: w,
581	      height: h,
582	      channels: img.channels,
583	      data: Bytes::from_array(out),
584	    },
585	    algorithm: DerainAlgorithm::Morphological,
586	    rain_streaks_removed: 0,
587	    processing_time_ms: 0.0,

451	pub fn calculate_ssim_sr(
452	  original : @types.Image,
453	  processed : @types.Image,
454	) -> Double {
455	  let w = original.width
456	  let h = original.height
457	  let total = w * h
458	  let mut sum1 = 0.0
459	  let mut sum2 = 0.0
460	  let mut sum12 = 0.0
461	  let mut sum1_sq = 0.0
462	  let mut sum2_sq = 0.0
463	
464	  for i in 0..<total {
465	    let p1 = original.data[i].to_double()
466	    let p2 = processed.data[i].to_double()
467	    sum1 += p1
468	    sum2 += p2
469	    sum12 += p1 * p2
470	    sum1_sq += p1 * p1
471	    sum2_sq += p2 * p2
472	  }
473	
474	  let mean1 = sum1 / total.to_double()
475	  let mean2 = sum2 / total.to_double()
476	  let var1 = sum1_sq / total.to_double() - mean1 * mean1
477	  let var2 = sum2_sq / total.to_double() - mean2 * mean2
478	  let cov12 = sum12 / total.to_double() - mean1 * mean2
479	
480	  let c1 = 6.5025
481	  let c2 = 58.5225
482	  let numerator = (2.0 * mean1 * mean2 + c1) * (2.0 * cov12 + c2)
483	  let denominator = (mean1 * mean1 + mean2 * mean2 + c1) * (var1 + var2 + c2)
484	
485	  if denominator > 0.0 {

494	pub fn calculate_image_quality_metrics(
495	  original : @types.Image,
496	  processed : @types.Image,
497	) -> ImageQualityMetrics {
498	  let psnr = calculate_psnr_sr(original, processed)
499	  let ssim = calculate_ssim_sr(original, processed)
500	
501	  let w = original.width
502	  let h = original.height
503	  let total = w * h
504	  let mut mse = 0.0
505	  let mut mae = 0.0
506	  let mut sum1 = 0.0
507	  let mut sum2 = 0.0
508	  let mut sum12 = 0.0
509	
510	  for i in 0..<total {
511	    let p1 = original.data[i].to_double()
512	    let p2 = processed.data[i].to_double()
513	    let diff = p1 - p2
514	    mse += diff * diff
515	    mae += diff.abs()
516	    sum1 += p1
517	    sum2 += p2
518	    sum12 += p1 * p2
519	  }
520	  mse /= total.to_double()
521	  mae /= total.to_double()
522	
523	  let mean1 = sum1 / total.to_double()
524	  let mean2 = sum2 / total.to_double()
525	  let cov = sum12 / total.to_double() - mean1 * mean2
526	  let var1 = if total > 0 {
527	    let mut v = 0.0
528	    for i in 0..<total {
529	      let p = original.data[i].to_double()
530	      v += (p - mean1) * (p - mean1)
531	    }
532	    v / total.to_double()
533	  } else {
534	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
535	  }
536	  let var2 = if total > 0 {
537	    let mut v = 0.0
538	    for i in 0..<total {
539	      let p = processed.data[i].to_double()
540	      v += (p - mean2) * (p - mean2)
541	    }
542	    v / total.to_double()
543	  } else {
544	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
545	  }
546	  let correlation = if var1 > 0.0 && var2 > 0.0 {
547	    cov / (var1 * var2).sqrt()
548	  } else {
549	    0.0
550	  }
551	
552	  // 清晰度（基于梯度）
553	  let mut sharpness = 0.0
554	  for y in 1..<(h - 1) {
555	    for x in 1..<(w - 1) {
556	      let idx = y * w + x
557	      let gx = processed.data[idx + 1].to_double() -
558	        processed.data[idx - 1].to_double()
559	      let gy = processed.data[idx + w].to_double() -
560	        processed.data[idx - w].to_double()
561	      sharpness += (gx * gx + gy * gy).sqrt()
562	    }
563	  }
564	  sharpness /= total.to_double()
565	
566	  let noise_level = mse.sqrt()
567	  let overall_quality = if psnr > 40.0 && ssim > 0.95 {
568	    5.0
569	  } else if psnr > 30.0 && ssim > 0.9 {
570	    4.0	<-- UNCOVERED
571	  } else if psnr > 20.0 && ssim > 0.8 {
572	    3.0	<-- UNCOVERED
573	  } else {
574	    2.0
575	  }
576	
577	  ImageQualityMetrics::{
578	    psnr,
579	    ssim,
580	    mse,
581	    mae,
582	    correlation,
583	    sharpness,
584	    noise_level,
585	    overall_quality,
586	  }
587	}

591	pub fn enhance_image(
592	  img : @types.Image,
593	  config : EnhancementConfig,
594	) -> @types.Image {
595	  let w = img.width
596	  let h = img.height
597	  let total = w * h
598	  let out : Array[Byte] = []

605	
606	    // 对比度
607	    pixel = (pixel - 128.0) * config.contrast + 128.0

609	    // Gamma
610	    if config.gamma != 1.0 && config.gamma > 0.0 {

612	    }
613

615	      0.0
616	    } else if pixel > 255.0 {
617	      255.0
618	    } else {
619	      pixel
620	    }
621	    out.push(clamped.to_int().to_byte())
622	  }
623	
624	  let mut result = @types.Image::{
625	    width: w,
626	    height: h,
627	    channels: img.channels,
628	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),
629	  }
630	
631	  // 去噪
632	  if config.denoise > 0.0 {
633	    result = denoise_image(result, config.denoise)
634	  }
635	
636	  // 锐化
637	  if config.sharpness > 0.0 {
638	    result = sharpen_image(result, config.sharpness)
639	  }
640	
641	  result
642	}
